career.townstead.tailor.description: Sews clothing at whatever sewing station the village has built, and keeps its people dressed for the season.
career.townstead.climatologist.descripti: Fetches supplies from the Fuel Store and Icehouse to keep village boilers and coolers stocked.
career.townstead.beverage_artisan.descri: A craftsperson of drinks, from everyday refreshments to specialist vintages.
career.townstead.cook.description: Turn everyday ingredients into nourishing meals and a lifetime at the stove into culinary mastery.
skill.townstead.cook.hot_hands.descripti: A cook's heat reaches every pot nearby. Cooking stations within 3 blocks of you work 25% faster.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.oven_mout: Open the oven and let it breathe. Hot Stone covers a 5 by 5 patch in place of 3 by 3.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.starter_c: A starter that lives by the fire learns to love the heat. Near a lit fire, you take half damage from fire.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.kitchen_r: Dough, peel, and oven settle into a practiced rhythm. After you finish Cook work, you gain Haste for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.into_the_: Everything goes in the oven eventually. A creature that is burning one second after Peel Slam hits it takes 6 damage and burns for 8 seconds, and Hot Stone lasts 30 seconds. Peel Slam itself deals no damage.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_slam: The flat of the peel does the talking. You strike the creature in front of you for 6 damage and knock it far back.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_ove: Read the oven by its heat, stone, and breath instead of by the clock. Pizzas baking within 3 blocks of you bake 50% faster.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_vaul: A pizza peel is a lever when the floor gets too hot to trust. You vault forward and up.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.blistered: The best crust carries the small scars of fierce heat. With at least 25 Char, creatures that hit you catch fire.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_swee: Clear the floor with the same broad motion that turns a pie. Peel Slam hits every hostile creature in a wide arc within 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_wis: Every oven has a temperament; you have learned how to listen. With at least 50 Char, pizzas baking within 3 blocks of you bake twice as fast.
Over, not through. Peel Vault clears fences and walls, and you take no fall damage for 5 seconds after it.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.long_reac: The peel gets there first. You slide the peel out to the dropped item you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, and bring it back.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.long_hand: Everything in the oven is in reach. Long Reach also strikes the creature you aim at for 3 damage and drags it toward you.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.pala.desc: The long peel of the old ovens. Peel Vault carries you almost twice as far, and Long Reach reaches 16 blocks. Your attacks are 20% slower.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.hot_stone: Straight from the oven floor. You drop a glowing baking stone on the ground where you aim for 15 seconds. Creatures that touch it burn for 4 seconds.
career.townstead.scribe.description: The village's pen—keeping the Archives, printing the bulletin, and helping neighbors find their calling.
skill.townstead.scribe.steady_hand.descr: A clear hand keeps every name, tally, and promise fit to be read again. Near a lectern in the Archives, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.shorth: Every conversation is a chance to take notes. While talking with someone, you recover energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.stakeo: Patience, and a good view. While you sneak, you read the name and health of the creature you look at.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.nose_f: A story always leaves a trail. With at least 25 Scoop, chests, barrels and spawners within 8 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.scoop_: Everybody has read it. With at least 50 Scoop, a creature you used Scandal on glows within 32 blocks for 5 minutes.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.byline: Your name on it. Scandal reaches creatures within 12 blocks of its target.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.front_: It runs above the fold. A Watch Post lasts 20 minutes, and a creature it or Tip-off shows keeps glowing for 60 seconds. Scandal and Retraction do not work while a Watch Post is set.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.tip_of: A little bird told you. One hostile creature within 48 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.extra_: Read all about it. Scandal reaches creatures within 16 blocks of its target, and Retraction reaches 16 blocks. Ten seconds after a Scandal, hostile creatures within 16 blocks of you come for you.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.source: Somebody always talks. Every 5 seconds, one hostile creature within 32 blocks glows.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.follow: One lead opens the next. Tip-off shows up to 3 hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.watch_: Eyes where you are not. You fix a watch point where you stand for 10 minutes. Hostile creatures within 16 blocks of it glow, and a shutter clicks.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.two_an: A wider shot. A Watch Post sees 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.scanda: Print it. Other hostile creatures within 8 blocks of the creature you aim at attack it.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.retrac: We regret the error. You and allies within 8 blocks lose your harmful effects, and hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Slowness and Weakness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.journalist.correc: In bold type. What Retraction sends back is Slowness II and Weakness II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.courtesy: Good manners cost nothing and open every door. While talking with someone, you recover energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.safe_con: An envoy under a white flag is no target. Illagers and other raiders ignore you while you hold no weapon. If you attack, they notice you for one minute.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.accord.d: Trust protects everyone. With at least 25 Goodwill, allies within 8 blocks take 10% less damage.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.peacemak: Few want to fight someone everyone trusts. With at least 50 Goodwill, hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Weakness II.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.composur: A diplomat never shows strain. Poison, Wither, Weakness, Slowness, Blindness, Nausea and Hunger last half as long on you.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.olive_br: An open hand slows an angry step. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks drop their target and stand still for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.parley.d: Talk first. Olive Branch also holds the creature you aim at, within 16 blocks, for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.sanctuar: No blood here. A field stands where you are for 15 seconds. Hostile creatures inside it can barely strike.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.grand_ac: Everyone at one table. Envoy's Favor reaches players within 32 blocks, and Make the Rounds reaches up to 16 residents. Neither works while you hold a weapon.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.open_doo: All are welcome. Allies inside the Sanctuary lose their harmful effects.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.envoys_f: A good word in the right ear. Players within 8 blocks gain Hero of the Village for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.treaty.d: Signed and sealed. Players within 4 blocks gain Hero of the Village II from Envoy's Favor.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.make_the: Every door, every name. A villager Diplomat visits up to 8 residents of the village, nearest first, and stops with each for a moment.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.introduc: You know everyone. Make the Rounds reaches up to 12 residents.
skill.townstead.scribe.diplomat.ceasefir: Weapons down, yours too. Sanctuary reaches 8 blocks and lasts 30 seconds, and Olive Branch holds for 6 seconds. For 30 seconds after either, your attacks deal no damage.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.catalog: You know where things are kept. Chests and barrels within 6 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.fair_co: Written down, it stays. You earn 15% more experience.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.chronic: It goes on the record. Whatever hurts you glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.dead_le: The ink does not wash out. With at least 25 Ink, creatures you stained with Ink Splash glow within 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.living_: Nothing they did is forgotten. With at least 50 Ink, creatures you stained with Ink Splash suffer Weakness II within 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.index.d: Third shelf, second box. A line of light leads from you to the nearest container within 16 blocks that holds the item in your hand.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.cross_r: One list points to the next. Index reaches 32 blocks.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.requisi: Signed for. One stack of the item in your hand comes to your pack from the nearest container within 8 blocks that holds it.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.standin: They know your hand. Requisition reaches 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.head_ar: Every shelf answers to you. Index reaches 64 blocks, and Requisition reaches 32 blocks. Each use spends all your Ink.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.ink_spl: Right in the eyes. The creature you aim at, up to 12 blocks away, is stained. It suffers Blindness for 5 seconds, drops its target and stands still for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.blot.de: It gets everywhere. Ink Splash also stains hostile creatures within 3 blocks of its target.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.by_the_: The rules protect those who keep them. Allies within 8 blocks gain a ward that spares 10 damage for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.rule_of: Breaking it has a price. When a By the Book ward breaks, hostile creatures within 4 blocks of that ally suffer Slowness II and glow for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.archivist.red_tap: Everything in triplicate. Ink Splash holds for 4 seconds, and By the Book wards spare 16 damage. After either, you suffer Slowness III for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.scribe.notice.descriptio: Posted for all to see. A column of light stands where you are for 5 minutes. Anyone can see it from afar.
career.townstead.baker.description: A cook devoted to the oven, from daily bread to fine pastry.
skill.townstead.baker.early_riser.descri: The bread is in the oven before the rooster wakes. Around dawn, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.fine_c: A tidy kitchen is a quick kitchen. In the bakery, you and allies within 6 blocks gain Haste.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sugar_: A little sweetness settles any stomach. With at least 25 Proof, Poison and Hunger are cleared from you and allies within 8 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.patiss: When the whole shop is rising, so is everyone in it. With at least 50 Proof, you keep Speed and Haste, and allies within 8 blocks keep Haste.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.candy_: Spun sugar is light enough to float away, and so is anyone caught in it. Hostile creatures within 6 blocks float up for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.spun_s: The air turns to candy floss. Creatures lifted by Candy Floss take 3 damage when they come down, and Sugar Glass spares 9 damage. Candy Floss lifts you too.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.grand_: The last course lights the whole room. Piping sets off a sugar firework that blinds hostile creatures within 4 blocks of you for 3 seconds, and Icing lasts 2 minutes. Each use costs 10 Proof more.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sweet_: One bite and you are off. When you eat, you gain Speed for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.glazed: A thin shell, well set. While a ward protects you, you take 10% less damage.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.piping: A steady hand finishes every cake with a flourish. You light every candle within 8 blocks. If all are lit, you put them out.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sparkl: And the hearth while you are at it. Piping also lights and puts out campfires.
Smooth as a mirror. A 3 by 3 patch of ground where you aim becomes slippery for 30 seconds. Anything on it slides the way it faces.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.royal_: Set hard and polished. Creatures on Icing slide twice as fast.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sticky: Arms full of sugar. Creatures lifted by Candy Floss can barely strike while they float.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sugar_: Clear, sweet and brittle. Allies within 6 blocks gain a ward that spares 6 damage for 15 seconds. When it breaks it shatters: the attacker takes 2 damage and is slowed.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.carame: Mind the shards. When Sugar Glass shatters, sharp caramel covers the ground around its wearer for 5 seconds and hurts hostile creatures that cross it.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.clean_ja: Good jam starts with good fruit. In the village, one unripe sweet berry bush within 6 blocks ripens a stage every 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.honey_ke: Bees work harder for a keeper they trust. In the village, one beehive within 6 blocks gains honey every 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.pantry.d: A full pantry makes the orchard eager. With at least 25 Proof, one unripe sweet berry bush within 6 blocks ripens a stage every 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.harvest_: Nothing in your care goes untended. With at least 50 Proof, in the village, every 20 seconds one sweet berry bush and one beehive within 8 blocks gain a stage of fruit or honey.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.jam_jar_: A broken jar makes a sticky floor. Jam splashes 3 blocks wide where you aim. The creature you aim at and those within 2 blocks of it cannot jump for 10 seconds, and bees within 16 blocks attack them.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.setting_: Know the instant jam sets, and your enemies with it. Jammed creatures also suffer Slowness II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.jam_sess: Every jar in the pantry, all at once. Thorns rise under creatures you jam, and Bramble Ward jams hostile creatures within 4 blocks. Each use costs 10 Proof more.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.bee_frie: The hives know your hands. Bees never attack you.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.bramble_: An old orchard defends itself. A ring of thorns rises 3 blocks out around you for 20 seconds. It slows and scratches hostile creatures and lets allies pass.
The bees know the way. With a bee within 16 blocks, the crop or flower you aim at is pollinated once.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.gentle_s: They stop at home on the way. Beeline also adds one level of honey to a beehive within 5 blocks.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.glaze.de: Thick, shining, and impossible to cross. The ground you aim at becomes sticky for 60 seconds. Anything on it can barely move.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.flypaper: Stuck, and seen. Creatures on Glaze also cannot jump, and they glow.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.queen_be: The hive answers to you. Beeline pollinates a 3 by 3 patch, and Glaze covers 5 by 5 in place of 3 by 3. Each use costs 10 Proof more.
Too dense to shoot through. While the thorns stand, you take half damage from projectiles.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.vermin_keep: No mill tolerates pests. Silverfish, endermites, and spiders keep away from you.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.threshing_f: The fields keep pace with the mill. In the village, one unripe wheat crop within 8 blocks grows a stage every 30 seconds.
A split sack fills the air in an instant. You raise a flour cloud around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.chaff.descr: Hard to hit what the air hides. When Whiteout rises, you and allies within 4 blocks take half damage from projectiles for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.whiteout.de: Nobody sees anything. For 10 seconds a flour cloud follows you.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.windmill.de: Full sail, full strength. Winnow reaches 10 blocks and pushes creatures in its cone, and Flour Trail is 18 blocks long. Each use costs 10 Proof more.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.dusty.descr: Flour is home. Inside a cloud of flour, smoke or any other haze, you gain Speed.
Fine enough to hang in the eyes. With at least 25 Proof, your flour clouds blind hostile creatures inside them.
It never quite settles. With at least 50 Proof, your flour clouds last twice as long.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.winnow.desc: Wheat from chaff. You blow away snow layers, leaves, cobwebs and fire in a cone 5 blocks long.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.clean_sweep: And the sparks with it. Winnow also puts out fire on you and allies within 5 blocks.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.flour_trail: Nothing crosses it unseen. You lay a line of flour 9 blocks ahead of you for 30 seconds. Creatures that cross it glow for 5 seconds.
White tracks all the way home. Creatures that cross a Flour Trail glow for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.flash_point: Flour and flame do not mix quietly. If you burn or a fire is within 3 blocks when Sack Burst rises, the cloud bursts. Everything within 4 blocks takes 6 damage, you included.
skill.townstead.baker.miller.dust_explos: One spark is enough. A hit you land while you stand in your own cloud makes it burst: everything within 8 blocks takes 6 damage, you included. Once every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.baker.oven_mitts.descrip: Straight from the oven. You gain Fire Resistance for 10 seconds.
A day in the open air keeps you going. Outdoors in daylight, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.field_hand.descri: A full can and a steady arm. Farmland within 4 blocks of you becomes wet.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.calloused_ha: Years at the hoe build a grip that hits hard. Attacks with a hoe deal 4 more damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.hamstring.de: Cut low, like cutting wheat. Creatures you hit with a hoe suffer Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.wide_swing.d: Clear the row in one pass. When you harvest a crop with a hoe, you also harvest the ripe crops on either side.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.reap.descrip: Swing low and wide. You strike hostile creatures in an arc in front of you for 4 damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.sweep_the_ro: The tip of the blade does the work. Creatures at the far end of Reap, 3 blocks or more from you, take double damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.hold_the_lin: Shoulder to shoulder, nobody breaks. Those called by Pitchforks also gain a ward that spares 6 damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.levee_en_mas: The whole village answers. Pitchforks reaches 24 blocks, and Reap hits a little harder with 2 or more allies within 6 blocks. Half the damage taken by those you called comes to you.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.stubborn.des: Try to move a farmer off the land. With at least 25 Grit, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.many_hands.d: Light work. With at least 50 Grit, each ally within 6 blocks who holds a tool or a sword adds 1 damage to your attacks, up to 4.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.reap_row.des: One swing, one row. With a hoe, you harvest the ripe crops in a line 5 blocks ahead of you into your pack.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.gleaner.desc: To the end of the row. Reap Row reaches 9 blocks.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.clear_ground: Make room for the plow. With a hoe, you cut the grass, flowers and leaves in a 5 by 5 area ahead of you.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.mow.descript: Nothing left lying. What Clear Ground cuts goes to your pack.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.haymaker.des: A sweep as wide as the field. Reap Row is 3 rows wide and Clear Ground cuts 9 by 9. Each sweep costs your hoe 5 durability.
skill.townstead.farmer.levy.pitchforks.d: Every hand picks up a tool. For 15 seconds, creatures that hit a villager or ally within 12 blocks of you take 3 damage.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.hide_in: Stand still in the crops and you are just another stalk. While you stand still in crops or tall grass, hostile creatures do not notice you.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.scarecr: Nothing tramples a field you keep. Creatures within 8 blocks of you never trample farmland.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.stand_s: Something about you makes them keep their distance. With at least 25 Grit, while you stand still, common hostile creatures within 8 blocks avoid you.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.harvest: You are part of the landscape now. With at least 50 Grit, while you stand still, hostile creatures do not notice you anywhere.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.boo.des: Nothing startles like a scarecrow that moves. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks are pushed back and flee from you for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.dread_h: Everything in the field runs. Creatures frightened by Boo take 2 damage every second for 3 seconds. Your attacks deal no damage while you hold the Post.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.straw_d: Was that you, or the scarecrow? You leave a straw figure where you stand for 20 seconds. Hostile creatures within 12 blocks turn on it.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.scarecr: Plant yourself and let them come. While held, you cannot move, and hostile creatures within 4 blocks are pushed away from you. Drains 3 Grit every second.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.field_o: The whole field is watching. Straw Double stands for 60 seconds, and Crows cover 16 blocks. While a figure stands, you move 15% slower.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.crows_e: A scarecrow never blinks. While you stand still, hostile creatures within 16 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.swap.de: Gone while they look the other way. When Straw Double is set, you gain Speed II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.crows.d: They see everything from up there. Crows circle the place where you stand for 20 seconds. Everything under them glows.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.carrion: They do not only watch. Hostile creatures under your Crows are pecked and suffer Weakness.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.startle: They never saw it coming. Boo also blinds for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.farmer.scarecrow.straw_m: Nothing in there to hit. While you hold the Post, projectiles do you no harm.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.wide_furro: One pass of the hoe opens three rows. When you till a block, you also till the dirt on either side.
Plant your feet in good soil and nothing moves you. While standing on dirt, grass, or farmland, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.stomp.desc: Land hard and the ground answers. Landing from a fall sends out a shockwave that throws hostile creatures within 4 blocks into the air.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.bedrock_st: Like the stone under the soil. With at least 50 Grit, you gain Resistance while you stand on dirt, grass, or farmland.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.fault_line: The ground splits in a line. A ripple runs 7 blocks ahead of you. Creatures on it are thrown to either side.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.earthquake: The whole field heaves. For 3 seconds the ground within 6 blocks shakes. Hostile creatures on it are thrown about and can barely strike.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.plow_ahead: Lean in and go. With a hoe, you dash 5 blocks and till the dirt and grass you cross.
The hillside comes with it. Earthquake also leaves the ground within 5 blocks as mud.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.good_earth: Soil remembers who tends it. With at least 25 Grit, farmland within 6 blocks of you stays wet.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.seed_drill: Ready for seed. The farmland within 3 blocks of where Plow Ahead starts becomes wet.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.irrigate.d: The soil darkens at once. Farmland within 4 blocks of you becomes fully wet.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.mulch.desc: A wider reach for the same water. Irrigate reaches twice as far.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.breaking_g: No ground refuses you. Plow Ahead tills 3 blocks wide and also works on coarse dirt and paths, and Irrigate reaches 6 blocks. Each use costs your hoe 5 durability.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.furrow.des: What the ripple opens stays open. Fault Line leaves a line of mud 7 blocks long that slows hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.farmer.tiller.tectonic.d: The plates answer. Fault Line throws creatures in every direction around you, and Earthquake lasts 6 seconds. Earthquake shakes you too.
skill.townstead.fisherman.patient_line.d: The fish come to those who wait. While standing still near water, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.sea_legs.descr: Born for the water. You gain Dolphin's Grace for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.barb: A hook with a barb holds what it catches. Creatures you hit with a fishing rod take 2 extra damage and suffer Slowness for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.taut: Nothing near you gets slack. While you hold a fishing rod, hostile creatures within 4 blocks are slowed.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.set_: A patient wrist sets the hook early. You fish with 1 extra level of Lure.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.old_: A lifetime at sea has made you hard to beat. With at least 50 Tide and a fishing rod in hand, you gain Strength.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.get_: Hook it and haul it in. You pull the creature you aim at, up to 12 blocks away, to you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.snag: Once it is hooked, it is not going anywhere. A creature pulled by Get Over Here arrives staggered, and your hits on it within 2 seconds deal double damage.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.gaff: Nothing stays out of reach. With a fishing rod, you reel in the dropped item you aim at, up to 16 blocks away.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.traw: Drag the whole school in. You pull every hostile creature in front of you within 12 blocks to you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.levi: A line strong enough for anything in the sea. Get Over Here and Trawl reach 24 blocks. Each pull also drags you forward.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.cast: Cast the line and follow it. With a fishing rod, you pull yourself to the creature you aim at, up to 12 blocks away.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.hook: It swallowed the whole thing. Gaff also strikes the hostile creature you aim at for 4 damage and slows it, and Cast Off staggers its target. Each use costs 10 Tide more.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.sea_: The wet makes you stronger. With at least 25 Tide, in rain or in water, your pulls reach twice as far.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.long: People and animals too. While you sneak, Gaff pulls the ally or animal you aim at to you instead.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.boar: Arrive like you mean it. When Cast Off arrives, its target is knocked back and slowed.
skill.townstead.fisherman.harpooner.keel: Under the hull and out the other side. Wet creatures that Trawl pulls take 4 damage.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.web: You swim like you were born to it. In water, you gain Dolphin's Grace.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.dee: Everyone under, together. You and allies within 8 blocks gain Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.wea: Fish bite best when the sky turns gray. In rain, you fish with 1 extra level of Lure and Luck of the Sea.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.wal: The sea holds you up. With at least 50 Tide, you can walk on water. Sneak to sink.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.spl: A wall of spray. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks are pushed away and soaked for 10 seconds. A soaked creature stops burning, and blazes, magma cubes and striders take 4 damage.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.und: The current takes them. Soaked creatures within 8 blocks are dragged toward you every second.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.whi: The water turns and everything goes with it. A vortex spins around the creature you aim at for 6 seconds. Creatures within 6 blocks of it are pulled to it, slowed and dizzy.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.rip: Ride the current like a spear. When you cast Whirlpool, you dash 6 blocks and strike the first creature you reach for 4 damage.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.mae: The sea opens up. Whirlpool is centered on you, reaches 8 blocks and soaks everything in it, and Splash soaks for 20 seconds. You no longer choose where the Whirlpool spins.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.gil: One breath lasts a long dive. You can breathe underwater.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.dre: Too wet to burn. With at least 25 Tide, fire on you goes out, and so does fire within 1 block of you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.buo: Nobody stays down. Allies below half health under Deep Breath also gain Regeneration for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.wav: A wall of water with foam on top. A wave runs 12 blocks ahead of you, on land or water, and carries creatures along with it.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.sur: Ride it. Wave also carries you 8 blocks forward.
skill.townstead.fisherman.tidecaller.spr: What goes out comes back. Wave returns 3 seconds later and carries everything in front of you back, and Deep Breath lasts 60 seconds. Each use costs 10 Tide more.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.knot_wo: You know every knot, so none of them hold you. Cobwebs and berry bushes never slow you.
Every cast snarls something. Creatures you hit with a fishing rod suffer Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.full_ne: A heavy net is a good day. With at least 25 Tide, slowed creatures deal 20% less damage to you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.mended_: Every knot retied, and nothing slips through. You fish with 1 extra level of Luck of the Sea.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.master_: Nothing escapes your reach. With at least 50 Tide, hostile creatures within 6 blocks stay slowed.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.toss_ne: One throw, and they are caught. You throw nets under hostile creatures within 5 blocks. Nets heavily slow hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.great_n: The net that catches everything. Toss Net covers 12 blocks and Lure reaches 16. Each use costs 10 Tide more.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.lure.de: Wave the bait and they come to you instead. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack you, and you gain a ward that spares 8 damage for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.bait_an: Draw them in, then close the net. For 10 seconds after Lure, Toss Net also lands on every creature you lured within 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.chum.de: Blood in the water. For 20 seconds, fish bite much faster for you.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.the_big: The catch of a lifetime. Landing Net carries any creature up to your own size, and Chum slows hostile creatures within 8 blocks and makes them glow. A full net slows you by 30%.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.landing: Scoop it up. You net the small creature you aim at, such as a chicken, a rabbit or a baby animal, and carry it. Use it again to set it down.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.full_ca: A longer handle. Landing Net reaches 8 blocks in place of 4.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.feeding: They fight for the hook. Fish bite faster still during Chum.
skill.townstead.fisherman.netter.weighte: Lead in the hem. Netted creatures cannot jump for 5 seconds, and a net pulls flying creatures down.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.taste_t: Every drink is a chance to check the batch. When you finish a drink, you gain Speed for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.hospita: A drink and a seat for anyone who needs one. You and allies within 6 blocks recover energy.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.barista: Morning Cup
The first cup of the day. Around dawn, you gain 2 Buzz every second.
Steady Hands
Enough coffee to work fast, not enough to shake. With at least 50 Buzz, you gain Haste.
Crema
The sweet spot, right on top. While your Buzz is between 34 and 66, you gain Speed and Jump Boost.
Caffeinated
Wired and ready. With at least 67 Buzz, you gain Strength.
Perfect Pour
When the pour is perfect, everyone feels it. While your Buzz is between 34 and 66, you and allies within 6 blocks gain Haste.
Espresso Shot
Short, strong, and straight to the head. You gain Speed for 7 seconds and 20 Buzz. The more Buzz you already have, the stronger the Speed. At 100 Buzz you crash.
Double Shot
One for you, one for the table. Espresso Shot also gives Haste to allies within 4 blocks, stronger the more Buzz you have.
Rocket Fuel
Not recommended. Espresso Shot gives 40 Buzz with Speed III and Haste III, and Decaf leaves you with Haste II for 10 seconds. It almost always ends in a crash.
Jitters
Pass the shakes on to someone else. Hostile creatures within 6 blocks suffer Slowness II and Weakness for 8 seconds, stronger above 67 Buzz. It spends 30 Buzz.
Decaf
Sometimes you need to come down gently. Your Buzz drops to 0 with no crash.
Spilled Coffee
Hot, and all over the floor. Scalding coffee spills under hostile creatures within 8 blocks. It burns and slows them. It spends 40 Buzz.
Last Drop
Every last bit of the pot. Jitters and Spilled Coffee reach 12 blocks. Each spends 10 Buzz more.
Slow Sip
Not all the way down. Decaf leaves you at 34 Buzz.
Shakes
Hard to aim through that. Above 67 Buzz, Jitters also blinds for 5 seconds.
Wet Floor
Mind the sign. Creatures in the spill slide the way they face and cannot stop.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.bartend: Familiar Faces
You never forget a face. Anyone who spends about a minute near you becomes one of your regulars.
Bar Stool
Pull up a seat. Your regulars within 8 blocks recover energy every 5 seconds.
Heavy Hand
A bartender who can throw a punch. Your hits knock creatures far back.
Everybody Knows Your Name
Where everybody is glad you came. With at least 50 Tab, your regulars within 24 blocks keep Speed.
Eighty-Six
You're done here. You throw the creature you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, somewhere up to 12 blocks off.
Bum's Rush
Out, all of you. Eighty-Six also throws the creatures within 3 blocks of its target.
Closing Time
You don't have to go home, but you can't stay here. You throw every hostile creature within 10 blocks up to 16 blocks off.
Last Call
Last call, and the bar empties. Thrown creatures flee from you for 10 seconds. Your throws work only inside a building.
On the House
The bartender's special, and nobody knows what's in it. You and allies within 6 blocks gain a random drink effect for 10 seconds.
Round for the Regulars
This one's for the regulars. Your regulars within 24 blocks gain Speed and Haste for 15 seconds.
Toast
Raise a glass to the regulars. Round for the Regulars also gives Strength to regulars within 8 blocks of you.
Bottle Service
Everyone gets their own bottle. On the House gives each regular a strong effect for 20 seconds, and Round for the Regulars lasts 30 seconds. People who are not regulars get nothing from On the House.
Know Your Limit
A good bar keeps people on their feet. With at least 25 Tab, Nausea is cleared from you and your regulars within 24 blocks every second.
The Usual
You pour before they ask. Your regulars within 6 blocks get a second random drink effect from On the House.
Cut Off
That was your last one. Thrown creatures suffer Nausea for 10 seconds.
Cool Head
A brewer holds their drink. You are immune to Nausea.
Iron Liver
Nothing you drink can hurt you. You are immune to Poison.
Patient Fermentation
Learn when a living batch needs a hand. Brewing stands and brewing stations within 3 blocks of you work 25% faster.
Aged in Oak
Time makes everything stronger. With at least 25 Ferment, you gain Strength.
Vintage
A rare year. With at least 50 Ferment, your delayed effects arrive after 5 seconds in place of 10.
Tap the Keg
Open the tap and let it flow. Ale spills under hostile creatures within 4 blocks. Creatures in ale stagger and cannot walk straight.
Barrel Roll
Roll out the barrel. Tap the Keg also spills ale in a line 6 blocks ahead of you.
Flood the Cellar
Every cask at once. Ale you spill stays for 60 seconds, and Sour Mash spills it under its victims. Your ale staggers allies too.
Slow Brew
Good things take time. If you have not poured for 60 seconds, Second Pour gives Haste III.
Second Pour
The second glass is always better. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Haste II, 10 seconds from now, for 15 seconds.
Cask Strength
Straight from the cask, after a moment to breathe. 10 seconds from now, you gain Strength II and Resistance for 10 seconds.
Sour Mash
A bad batch does its work slowly. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks suffer Weakness now. 10 seconds later they suffer Poison II and Slowness II for 8 seconds.
Grand Cru
The finest you will ever pour. Second Pour and Cask Strength arrive after 30 seconds and are two levels stronger. If you are hit before a pour arrives, it is lost.
Share the Cask
A cask is too much for one. When Cask Strength arrives, allies within 8 blocks gain Regeneration for 10 seconds.
Hangover
The morning after lasts all day. The delayed part of Sour Mash lasts 16 seconds.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.winemak: Aeration
Let it breathe. Fermentation barrels within 3 blocks of you work 25% faster.
Bouquet
Every note, every scent. At dusk and dawn, creatures within 16 blocks glow.
Estate
The finest vineyard in the land. Lay Down keeps a pairing for 3 days, and a stored pairing pours at level III. Pouring a stored pairing empties your Vintage.
Grape Stomp
Stomp, stomp, stomp. Hostile creatures within 3 blocks are bounced and cannot jump for 5 seconds.
Crush
Into the vat with you. A Grape Stomp made while you fall bounces creatures twice as high.
Harvest Stomp
The whole village stomps. Grape Stomp lands 3 times, each wider than the last, and Pop the Cork fires 3 corks. You cannot move during the stomps.
Pairing
The right glass for the hour. You gain an effect for 10 seconds that depends on the hour: Haste in the morning, Strength in the afternoon, Speed in the evening, Night Vision at night.
Wine Flight
Something for everyone. Pairing also reaches allies within 6 blocks.
Vertical Tasting
Every year of the same wine, in order. Lay Down keeps the pairings you stored before, so you can hold one for each part of the day. Pairing pours the earliest one.
Nose
You know a glass before you taste it. Poison, Hunger and Nausea from food and drink last half as long on you.
Terroir
Home ground. With at least 25 Vintage, your pairing is one level stronger inside your own village.
Reserve
The good bottles last. With at least 50 Vintage, effects from your Pairing last 50% longer.
Lay Down
Put this hour away for later. You store the pairing of this hour for one day. Your next Pairing pours the stored one.
Pop the Cork
Mind your eye. The creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, is knocked far back and suffers Nausea for 8 seconds.
Sabrage
One clean stroke, two corks. The cork bounces to a second creature within 5 blocks.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.sandy_m: Sun Lover
Nothing beats a sunny day. In full sun, you gain Speed.
Sea Breeze
A fair wind off the water. For 30 seconds, you and allies within 8 blocks swim much faster.
Sunscreen
Reapply every two hours. Heat no longer affects your body temperature.
Endless Summer
It never has to end. Mocktail rolls two effects, and Sea Breeze gives Speed in full sun. Neither works at night.
Mocktail
All of the fun, none of the headache. You gain a random refreshing effect for 7 seconds.
Tropical Punch
A bowl for the whole beach. Allies within 6 blocks each roll their own effect from Mocktail.
Coconut Bomb
Heads up! The creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, takes 10 damage and suffers Nausea for 8 seconds.
Beach Ball
Incoming! You throw a ball that bounces between up to 4 hostile creatures within 8 blocks and knocks each one up and back.
Beach Party
Nobody fights at a party. A creature that is bounced or bonked can barely strike for 5 seconds. Coconut Bomb deals no damage.
Tan Lines
A day in the sun is a day well spent. In full sun, you recover energy every 5 seconds.
After Sun
Used to the heat. With at least 25 Tan, in full sun you gain Fire Resistance.
Golden Hour
Everyone looks good in this light. With at least 50 Tan, allies within 10 blocks in full sun gain Haste.
Fair Winds
And air to spare. Sea Breeze also gives Water Breathing for 30 seconds.
Volley
Keep it up. Beach Ball bounces between up to 8 creatures.
Split
Two halves, two heads. The coconut splits, and each half hits one more creature within 4 blocks for 5 damage.
skill.townstead.cleric.hallowed.descript: Faith guards the flesh. You are immune to Wither.
skill.townstead.cleric.benediction.descr: A quick blessing against what ails you. You clear harmful effects from yourself.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.hallowed: The ground near you is no place for the dead. Undead creatures within 6 blocks take damage every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.smite.de: Strike the dead with conviction. Your attacks deal 50% more damage to undead creatures.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.zeal.des: The nearer the dead, the brighter your faith. With at least 25 Faith, your hits knock undead creatures far back.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.undying_: What the dead carry cannot touch you. You are immune to Hunger and Poison.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.purifier: Your presence burns the dead. With at least 50 Faith, undead creatures within 8 blocks catch fire every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.turn_und: Begone! Undead creatures within 6 blocks flee from you for 5 seconds and are weakened. Other hostile creatures are pushed back.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.rebuke.d: The dead falter at your word. Undead creatures turned by Turn Undead also take 4 damage.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.exorcism: Cast them out. A banished creature flees from you for 3 seconds when it returns, and an undead one returns burning.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.dawnbrea: Let there be light. Banish takes every creature within 16 blocks that Turn Undead touched in the last 10 seconds. Banish no longer takes aim, and your attacks deal no damage until they return.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.toll_the: A deep note, heard by the dead. Undead creatures within 24 blocks glow for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.passing_: It weighs on them. Toll the Bell also slows the undead creatures it shows for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.candle.d: One small light. You set a blessed light where you stand for 60 seconds. Undead creatures within 6 blocks of it are driven away.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.vigil_ca: It burns through the night. A Candle lasts 5 minutes.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.consecra: Bell, book and candle. Toll the Bell reaches 48 blocks, and a Candle sets on fire the undead creatures it drives away. Each use costs 10 Faith more.
skill.townstead.cleric.exorcist.banish.d: Out of the world, for a moment. The creature you aim at is held outside the fight for 4 seconds: it cannot move or strike. An undead creature takes 8 damage when it returns.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.steady_: Nothing shakes a steady soul. You are immune to Nausea and Blindness.
A steady hand wastes no drop. Brewing stands within 3 blocks of you brew 25% faster.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.listeni: Those who suffer find you. With at least 25 Faith, harmful effects are cleared from allies within 8 blocks every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.grace.d: Grace falls where you stand. Harmful effects are cleared from you every 5 seconds.
Your pain shields others. With at least 50 Faith, each time you are hurt, allies within 8 blocks gain a ward that spares 2 damage for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.cleanse: Wash it away. You clear harmful effects from you and allies within 6 blocks.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.absolve: All is forgiven. Cleanse also puts out fire.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.miracle: Sometimes, prayers are answered. Cleanse reaches 16 blocks, and Absolution needs no aim: it reaches every ally within 8 blocks. Absolution spends all your Faith.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.stay_yo: A word, and the blow falls softer. A creature that breaks a Shield of Faith ward can barely strike for 1 second.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.shield_: Faith is a shield for all. You and allies within 6 blocks gain a ward that spares 4 damage for 10 seconds. Each time it spares a hit, it clears their harmful effects.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.last_ri: Not yet. For 8 seconds, the ally you aim at has a ward that spares 12 damage. If it breaks, they are healed for 4.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.sanctua: None shall fall here. When a Last Rites ward breaks, its wearer is pushed away from the attacker, and the attacker is blinded for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.deliver: Deliver us. Last Rites covers every ally within 10 blocks, and Shield of Faith spares 6 damage. Each Last Rites ward that breaks costs you 4 health.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.absolut: Go, and be whole. The ally you aim at is healed for 6 and loses every harmful effect.
skill.townstead.cleric.confessor.shriven: Lighter than before. An ally healed by Absolution also gains Regeneration for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.ascetic.d: Hunger holds no power over you. You are immune to Hunger.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.long_road: Every step is a prayer. While you walk, you recover energy every 5 seconds.
The road gives back what it takes. With at least 25 Faith, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.pilgrims_: Those who walk with you want for nothing. With at least 50 Faith, you and allies within 8 blocks recover thirst and energy every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.share_wat: A drink from your own flask. You and allies within 6 blocks recover thirst and lose Hunger and Poison.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.pilgrimag: The long walk, made light. Share Water and Shrine reach 12 blocks. Neither works inside a village.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.guiding_l: What you carry, you hand on. While you bear a load, creatures hit by Staff Sweep suffer Weakness and Slowness II for 8 seconds. Bear the Load costs you 2 health.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.humble.de: You threaten nothing. Wolves, bees, golems, endermen, piglins, polar bears, llamas and pandas never turn on you.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.loaves.de: What you have, they have. Share Water also feeds allies in its reach a little, and you grow hungrier.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.shrine.de: A place to sit by the road. You raise a wayside marker where you stand for 10 minutes. Allies within 6 blocks of it recover energy and thirst every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.milestone: Rest, and be mended. Allies at your Shrine also lose Slowness and gain Regeneration.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.staff_swe: The road has taught you this much. You trip the hostile creatures in an arc in front of you for 2 damage.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.walking_p: Nobody outruns a pilgrim. A tripped creature stays slowed for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.bear_the_: Give it to me. Every harmful effect on allies within 8 blocks is lifted, and you suffer Slowness for 16 seconds. For 20 seconds, Staff Sweep deals 4 more damage.
skill.townstead.cleric.pilgrim.penance.d: Carried, and set down sooner. The Slowness from Bear the Load lasts 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.well_travel: Your feet know the way. Outside the village, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.cartographer.compass_ros: Pick a direction and go. You gain Speed and Jump Boost for 15 seconds.
Sure Stride
Nothing on the trail trips you up. Cobwebs, berry bushes, and powder snow no longer slow you.
Trail Legs
Rough ground is just ground. You can step up full blocks without jumping.
Second Wind
The road gives you strength. With at least 25 Bearing, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
Homing
You always know the way back. With at least 50 Bearing, you gain Speed II outside the village.
Homeward
Home at last. A return to your waypoint brings every ally within 6 blocks with you, and Lead the Way lasts 60 seconds. After such a return, Waypoint and Lead the Way lock for 60 seconds.
Scout Ahead
Go and see. You dash forward, and for 3 seconds projectiles do you no harm.
Wide Survey
You draw what others walk past. Maps you carry fill in twice as wide.
Waypoint
A place worth coming back to. While you sneak, you set a waypoint where you stand. Otherwise, you return to it, which costs 25 Bearing.
Second Camp
The fire is already lit. When you return to your waypoint, you recover energy and lose Slowness.
Lead the Way
Keep up. For 30 seconds, you and allies within 10 blocks gain Speed II.
No One Left Behind
Count heads before you go. Lead the Way also pulls allies within 24 blocks toward you.
Double Back
The way out is the way in. While you sneak, Scout Ahead dashes backward.
Trailhead
Gone the way you came. You blink 8 blocks backward.
Ambuscade
They swing at where you were. Hostile creatures within 6 blocks of where you left are blinded for 2 seconds.
Pathfinder's Mark
They chase what is no longer there. Scout Ahead and Trailhead leave an afterimage for 2 seconds that hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack. Each use costs 10 Bearing more.
Ore Sense
You can feel the metal in the rock. Ores within 6 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
Strike It Rich
Deeper is richer. With at least 50 Bearing, ores within 12 blocks glint every 2 seconds.
Vein Sense
You feel the whole vein now. With at least 25 Bearing, ores within 10 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
Tap the Rock
Listen to the stone. Ores within 8 blocks glint for 10 seconds.
Echo Sound
The hollow places answer. Tap the Rock also shows dark hollows within 8 blocks.
Assay
You know where to strike. While ore is within 5 blocks, your pickaxe loses no durability.
Eureka
There it is! Tap the Rock reaches 16 blocks, and Core Sample reads a 3 by 3 column. Both are loud: hostile creatures within 24 blocks come for you. Each use costs 10 Bearing more.
Flare
Light them up. You blind hostile creatures within 8 blocks for 5 seconds, and they glow.
Dowser
The rod dips. Underground, water and lava within 8 blocks drip a glint every 5 seconds.
Core Sample
A long look straight down. You learn each kind of ore in the 64 blocks under you: how many blocks, and how far the nearest one is. Nothing is spent if there is none.
Stake a Claim
Mine. A Core Sample that finds ore leaves a beam of light on the spot for 5 minutes.
Sparkler
It sticks. The creature you aim at within 24 blocks when you use Flare glows for 30 seconds.
Pick Hammer
Strike the rock and let it fly. Stone flies in a cone 5 blocks long for 5 damage. Standing on stone, it deals 10.
Spall
Chips in the eyes. Creatures hit by Pick Hammer are blinded for 2 seconds.
Fool's Gold
They run from the glitter. Creatures blinded by Flare flee from you for 3 seconds, and so does a blinded creature that Pick Hammer hits. Your Flare blinds you for 1 second too.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.he: Heights never frighten you. You take half damage from falling.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.cl: Thin air, clear head. High up, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.ea: Nothing below goes unseen. With at least 25 Bearing, while you are high up or in the air, creatures within 32 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.cl: You walk on air. With at least 50 Bearing, you fall slowly while sneaking.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.up: Catch the wind. You leap high into the air and fall slowly for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.gl: Ride the air forward. Updraft also throws you forward, and you fall slowly for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.sk: Straight up, to see everything. Updraft takes you twice as high, and a fall within 15 seconds of Updraft or 10 seconds of Plumb Line does not count against you. Any other fall deals double damage.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.gr: You come down like weather. Dive needs no target: you plunge, and where you land hostile creatures within 5 blocks take 8 damage and are thrown back. Rockfall works only in the air.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.su: From up here, you see it all. High above the ground, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.pl: Straight down, and softly. You drop fast and take no fall damage for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.ra: Bring the crew down with you. Allies within 6 blocks also take no fall damage for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.ro: Kick them loose. Creatures within 5 blocks take 3 damage. If you are in the air, they take 6.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.sc: The slope does the rest. Creatures hit by Rockfall are knocked away from you.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.di: Out of the sun. From the air, you dive onto the creature you aim at within 24 blocks for 6 damage, or 12 if you have fallen 8 blocks or more. You take no fall damage.
skill.townstead.cartographer.surveyor.sh: The ground feels it. Creatures within 3 blocks of the one Dive strikes are pushed away.
skill.townstead.shepherd.open_pasture.de: Grass underfoot, sky overhead. Outdoors in daylight, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.whistle.descrip: One whistle and they come. You call farm animals within 12 blocks toward you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.followin: They know your voice. Farm animals within 8 blocks slowly drift toward you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.keep_pac: No one gets left behind. Farm animals within 8 blocks gain Speed.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.fold.des: Safe in the fold. With at least 25 Flock, farm animals within 10 blocks take 30% less damage.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.bellweth: The whole flock follows the bell. Farm animals within 16 blocks follow you closely. Round Up reaches 24 blocks and Lead reaches 32. Each use costs 10 Flock more.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.round_up: Bring them in. You pull farm animals within 12 blocks to you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.pen.desc: Hold them there. Animals gathered by Round Up stand still for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.crook_sw: A shepherd's crook is a weapon too. You hook the legs of the creature you aim at. It falls and is dragged to one side.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.good_she: The good shepherd guards every one. For 5 seconds after Crook Swing or Stampede, farm animals near you take no damage. You take all of it.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.shepherd: A shepherd shears without forcing it. Near sheep, your shears lose no durability.
Count them every hour. With at least 50 Flock, a hurt farm animal within 24 blocks glows.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.lead.des: Move them along. You drive farm animals within 16 blocks away from you, and they keep running for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.sort.des: This lot, not that one. Lead only drives the animals in front of you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.hook.des: Your side, not theirs. While you sneak, Crook Swing drags the creature to the other side.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.stampede: The ground shakes. You charge 8 blocks, and farm animals within 12 blocks run with you. Hostile creatures in your path take 4 damage and are knocked down. With 3 or more animals, the charge is twice as wide.
skill.townstead.shepherd.herder.back_to_: And settle. Animals that ran with a Stampede stand still for 5 seconds when it ends.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.nig: Long nights with the flock. At night, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.lig: You rest with one eye open. At night, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.daw: Strongest just before dawn. With at least 50 Flock, at night, you gain Strength.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.ala: Wake up! Sleeping villagers within 32 blocks wake, and hostile creatures within 32 blocks glow for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.tor: Hold up the torch. You blind hostile creatures within 8 blocks for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.lon: It will be a long night. A Lantern burns for 10 minutes, and Alarm reaches 64 blocks. Each use costs 10 Flock more.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.sen: Nothing moves that you do not see. While you stand still, hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.dog: The hours nobody else wants. With at least 25 Flock, at night you recover energy every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.all: Eyes open, heads clear. Alarm also clears Blindness and Darkness from you and allies in its reach.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.lan: A light where it is needed. You hang a lantern where you stand for 5 minutes. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks of it glow.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.cha: One light answers the next. A Lantern lights 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.daz: They swing at shadows. Creatures blinded by Torchlight also suffer Weakness II.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.sig: A bright star that drifts down. Hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.par: It hangs there. Signal Flare lasts 40 seconds, and phantoms flee from you while it burns.
skill.townstead.shepherd.night_watch.wat: They stand because you do. When you use Torchlight or Signal Flare, allies within 16 blocks take 20% less damage while it lasts.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.good: Walkies! Your tamed pets within 8 blocks gain Speed.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.loya: They would do anything for you. Your tamed pets within 8 blocks take 20% less damage.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.pack: Never alone. For 30 seconds after Heel or Fetch, you take 30% of the damage your tamed pets within 24 blocks would take.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.alph: They follow the strongest. With at least 25 Flock, your tamed pets within 10 blocks gain Strength.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.pack: The whole pack moves as one. With at least 50 Flock, your tamed pets within 16 blocks gain Strength II and take 30% less damage.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.heel: Here, now. You call your tamed pets within 24 blocks to you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.sic_: Get them! Your tamed pets within 16 blocks of the creature you aim at attack it. It is knocked down for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.rele: Let them loose. Sic 'Em gives your pets Strength II for 10 seconds, and Guard Dog wards spare 16 damage. Each use costs 10 Flock more.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.trea: Who's a good boy? A pet whose Guard Dog ward breaks gains Speed II and Strength II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.stay: Stay put, good pet. While you sneak, Heel tells your pets within 24 blocks to hold still for 30 seconds instead.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.guar: A good guard never falls. Your tamed pets within 16 blocks gain a ward that spares 8 damage for 15 seconds, and hostile creatures within 12 blocks of a pet turn on it.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.scen: They smell it before you see it. While a tamed pet is within 8 blocks, hostile creatures within 16 blocks of you glow.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.fetc: Go get it. With a tamed pet within 8 blocks, the dropped item you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, is brought to you.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.retr: Good work earns a treat. Fetch also heals your tamed pets within 16 blocks for 4 health.
skill.townstead.shepherd.packmaster.flan: Room to get around it. The target of Sic 'Em stays slowed for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.strong_stomach.d: Nothing turns your stomach. You are immune to Hunger.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.keen_edg: A clean cut bleeds. Creatures you hit with a cleaver or axe bleed, taking 1 damage every second for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.butchers: The cleaver is part of your arm. With at least 50 Cut, your attacks deal 25% more damage to bleeding creatures.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.bloodlus: The work quickens your blood. With at least 25 Cut, you gain Speed while a bleeding creature is within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.deep_cut: Cut deeper. Hack on a creature that already bleeds adds a bleed stack, up to 3.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.hemorrha: Some wounds never close. Bleeding creatures deal 20% less damage to you. Butcher's Block deals half its base damage.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.hack.des: Hack at it. You strike hostile creatures in an arc in front of you for 3 damage and make them bleed for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.butchers: One heavy chop. You strike the creature you aim at for 6 damage, and 2 more for each of its bleed stacks. The stacks are spent.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.carve_up: Everything within reach. When Butcher's Block kills, creatures within 3 blocks of the body bleed for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.slaughte: The whole yard. Throw Cleaver makes what it strikes bleed for 6 seconds, and Blood Trail reaches 48 blocks. Each use costs 10 Cut more.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.keen_ste: A sharp blade does less work. Cleavers and axes you use lose durability half as often.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.dress_th: Nothing wasted. When you kill a bleeding creature, you gain 10 Cut.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.throw_cl: It comes back, usually. You throw your cleaver 12 blocks ahead. It cuts leaves, vines, cobwebs and string in its path and strikes the creature you aim at for 3 damage.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.lodge.de: Stuck fast. The creature Throw Cleaver strikes is slowed for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.blood_tr: They cannot hide what they are losing. For 30 seconds, bleeding creatures within 16 blocks glow through walls and drip where they go.
skill.townstead.butcher.cleaver.hound.de: Nose down, feet quick. During Blood Trail, wounded creatures glow too, and you gain Speed while a bleeding creature is within 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.malle: Every blow lands heavy. Creatures you hit with a meat hammer are knocked back and suffer Slowness for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.tende: The right blow spares the hammer. Meat hammers you use lose no durability.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.rhyth: Find the beat of the work. Each Tenderize within 3 seconds of the last one adds a beat, up to 3. Each beat adds 1 damage to Tenderize.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.momen: The longer you work, the harder you hit. While a hostile creature is within 8 blocks, you slowly build up Strength, up to Strength II.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.bone_: Nothing gets back up. One heavy blow for 8 damage. The target can barely strike for 2 seconds, then suffers Weakness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.tende: Soften them up. You strike the creature you aim at for 3 damage, and it suffers Weakness II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.malle: Swing at everything. At 3 beats, Bone Breaker hits every hostile creature within 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.meat_: Nothing comes out whole. Beats last 5 seconds, and at 3 beats Bone Breaker deals 3 more damage. While you hold a beat, Tenderize costs 5 stamina more.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.tough: Years of hard work harden you. With at least 50 Cut, slowed creatures deal half damage to you.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.iron_: Unstoppable. What Heave throws hurts creatures within 4 blocks of where it lands, and Drive pushes a row of up to 6 blocks. Each use costs 10 Cut more.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.butch: Feet wide, hammer high. With at least 25 Cut, you cannot be knocked back while you hold a meat hammer.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.heave: Up, and over. You throw the animal you aim at where you look. It lands unhurt. Creatures within 2 blocks of where it lands take 4 damage and are slowed.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.stron: Anything with legs. You can throw hostile creatures too. A thrown hostile creature takes 4 damage when it lands.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.drive: One blow, one block. You hammer the block you aim at 1 block away from you.
skill.townstead.butcher.tenderizer.wedge: The row goes with it. Drive pushes a row of up to 3 blocks.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.cured: Years by the smoker toughen you. You take half damage from fire.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.smoke: Good smoke takes time, unless you tend it. Smokers within 3 blocks of you smoke 25% faster.
Salt and smoke keep everything good. Poison and Hunger are cleared from you every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.smoke: Nobody sees anything in here. Puff reaches 5 blocks and Hot Coals reaches 9. Each use costs 10 Cut more.
A puff of smoke. You raise a cloud of smoke around you. Creatures lose sight of anyone inside it.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.smoul: Let it smolder. Puff also gives Weakness for 5 seconds to hostile creatures within 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.smoke: Smoke them out. Creatures within 8 blocks lose Invisibility and glow for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.hot_c: Rake out the coals. You spread hot coals under hostile creatures within 6 blocks. Coals burn hostile creatures that stand on them for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.flare: The fire catches. Creatures your Hot Coals are spread under also catch fire for 3 seconds at once.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.burnt: Everything gets well done. With at least 50 Cut, your Hot Coals burn for 5 seconds in place of 2.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.banke: A fire kept right cooks by itself. With at least 25 Cut, campfires within 4 blocks cook 25% faster.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.ember: Fire travels in a careful hand. You take the fire from the lit campfire, furnace or smoker you aim at and carry it for 5 minutes. Use it again on an unlit one to light it.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.tinde: A coal for the road. While you sneak, a carried ember is set on the ground in front of you as hot coals.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.clean: Good smoke carries the bad away. Smoke Out also clears Poison and Hunger from you and allies in its reach.
skill.townstead.butcher.smokehouse.pit_m: The fire knows your hands. While you carry an ember, fire does not harm you, and Smoke Out reaches 16 blocks. In rain, neither tool works.
skill.townstead.butcher.size_up.descript: You know a good cut when you see one. You read the name and health of the creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away.
skill.townstead.armorer.iron_skin.descri: Armor is a second skin to you. You take 10% less damage from attacks while wearing a chestplate.
skill.townstead.armorer.patch_up.descrip: A quick fix in the field. You repair some durability on the armor you are wearing.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.arrow_ca: Let them shoot. You take 40% less damage from projectiles.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.proofed_: Plate proofed at the forge takes less wear. Armor you wear loses durability half as often.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.fireproo: Tempered in the forge. With at least 25 Temper, you take 40% less damage from fire.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.unbreaka: Nothing gets through. With at least 50 Temper, you take 30% less damage from everything.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.last_bas: They shall not pass. While Iron Wall is held, an ally in it who drops below 30% health gains a ward that spares 8 damage. Once every 30 seconds for each ally.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.cover.de: Get behind me. Projectiles that hit your guarded ally do them no harm. You take that damage.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.iron_wal: A wall of steel for everyone. While held, allies within 8 blocks gain Resistance II and you move slowly. Drains 4 Temper every second.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.aegis.de: The village's shield. Guard sends you three quarters of the damage, and you take a quarter of the damage of every ally inside Iron Wall. Each such hit gives 2 Temper. Your attacks deal no damage while either is active.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.braced.d: Feet set, shoulders square. While you Guard, hold Iron Wall, or Stand Fast, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.douse.de: Steam and a hiss. You put out fire on you and allies within 8 blocks, and all of you gain a ward that spares 8 fire damage for 20 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.blast_pl: Built for the worst day. The Douse ward also spares explosion damage.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.stand_fa: Here, and no further. While held, nothing moves you: no knockback, no water current, and hostile creatures are pushed out of your space. Drains 2 Temper every second.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.rally_po: Form on me. While you Stand Fast, you glow through walls, and allies within 3 blocks lose Slowness.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.living_s: Behind me. While a Douse ward or Stand Fast is active, allies within 2 blocks take no projectile or explosion damage. You take all of it.
skill.townstead.armorer.bulwark.guard.de: That one is mine to keep. You guard the ally you aim at for 15 seconds. Half the damage they take comes to you.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.car: You look after your kit. Every minute, your worn armor recovers a little durability.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.bel: A steady bellows keeps the fire hot. Furnaces and blast furnaces within 3 blocks of you smelt 25% faster.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.tin: You spot every dent. With at least 25 Temper, an ally within 8 blocks who drops below half health gains a ward that spares 4 damage. Once every 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.qua: Everyone's kit stays in shape. The armor of you and allies within 8 blocks recovers a little durability every 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.mas: Your work holds. With at least 50 Temper, allies within 8 blocks take 15% less damage.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.fie: Hold still, I'll fix it. You repair the armor of the ally you are aiming at.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.men: Everyone's armor, one pass. Field Repair also repairs allies within 6 blocks of the one you aim at.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.ham: Beat out the dents. Reforge also removes the item's added anvil cost from earlier repairs.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.arm: The whole garrison, refitted. Field Repair and Reforge need no aim and no anvil, and reach everyone within 8 blocks. Both cost twice as much.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.rei: Another plate here. A Padding ward that breaks bursts, and knocks the attacker back.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.pad: Softer landings. You and allies within 6 blocks gain a ward that spares 4 damage for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.tem: Hardened to the core. The ally you aim at gains a ward that spares 12 damage for 15 seconds. When it breaks or ends, it bursts for half of what it spared.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.fir: Flame-proofed. Tempered Steel also puts out fire on the ally, and its ward spares all fire damage.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.mas: Your finest work, on everyone but you. When a ward you placed breaks, you gain 10 Temper. Your Padding no longer covers you.
skill.townstead.armorer.field_mender.ref: Temper does what iron would. At an anvil, you repair the item in your hand by 300 durability, with no materials.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.heav: Built like an anvil. You gain knockback resistance.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.iron: Hard to hurt. You take 20% less damage from attacks while wearing a chestplate.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.weig: Every step is a statement. Creatures you hit are knocked back twice as far.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.immo: Nothing moves you. With at least 25 Temper, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.jugg: Unstoppable once you start. With at least 50 Temper, Slowness cannot hold you outside Plate Stance.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.plat: Lock the plates. While held, you gain Resistance III and move slowly, and creatures that hit you are knocked back. Drains 4 Temper every second.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.anch: Drop anchor. Creatures that hit you in Plate Stance also suffer Weakness for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.shou: Out of the way. You dash 5 blocks and knock aside up to 3 creatures in your path.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.tram: Go through, not around. Creatures hit by Shoulder Barge take 3 damage and suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.batt: Nothing stands. While Iron Tread or Plunge carries you, you smash through glass, ice and leaves. Each block costs 5 Temper.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.eart: Land like a falling anvil. When Plunge lands, hostile creatures within 4 blocks are thrown into the air.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.iron: Nothing is left standing. When Plate Stance is released or Shoulder Barge ends, you spend all your Temper. Hostile creatures within 5 blocks take 1 damage for each 10 Temper spent and are thrown back.
Let the iron take you down. While held, you sink in water and walk along the bottom at full speed. Drains 4 stamina every second.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.deep: One breath is enough. Iron Tread also lets you breathe underwater while it is held.
skill.townstead.armorer.heavyweight.plun: Drop like an anvil. In the air, you drop straight down and take no fall damage when you land.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.balanced_gri: A blade that fits the hand. Attacks with a sword or axe deal 10% more damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.whetstone.de: A few strokes of the stone. You repair some durability on the weapon in your hand.
