skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.bala: A well-balanced blade is easy to rework. Anvil work on your swords and axes does not raise their repair cost.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.blad: Never where they strike. With at least 50 Edge, you gain Speed II while you hold a sword or axe.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.lung: Close the distance. After a parry that spares a hit, you spring at the attacker and strike it for 6 in place of 2.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.mast: The finest duelist in the land. During a Challenge, Footwork costs no stamina, and when the creature you challenged dies, you gain 30 Edge. Outside a Challenge, Footwork costs twice as much.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.disa: Knock it from their hand. The creature you aim at drops its weapon and suffers Weakness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.swee: Everyone drops it. Disarm also reaches the creatures on either side of its target.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.humi: You were never a match. A creature you parry is also disarmed, and disarmed creatures flee from you for 5 seconds. Your parry lasts half as long.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.pois: Weight on the back foot. Holding a sword or axe, you are knocked back half as far.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.coun: Every attack opens a gap. After a parry that spares a hit, your next hit within 3 seconds deals double damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.seco: The first move was the lie. With at least 25 Edge, the first hit you land after Footwork staggers its target.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.foot: Never stand where you stood. You dash 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.pass: Through, not around. During Footwork, hits against you are spared.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.chal: You, and nobody else. You challenge the creature you aim at for 10 seconds. It attacks only you, and each of you deals 25% more damage to the other.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.duelist.hono: A duel is watched, not joined. During a Challenge, other hostile creatures do not attack you.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.honed_: Always sharp. Attacks with a sword or axe deal 20% more damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.keep_i: A stroke of the stone between fights. Every minute, the weapon in your hand recovers a little durability.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.buildi: The longer the fight, the keener the blade. While a hostile creature is within 8 blocks, you slowly build up Strength, up to Strength II.
Sharp enough to split a hair. With at least 50 Edge, attacks with a sword or axe deal 50% more damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.keen_s: Straight through. You strike the creature you aim at for heavy damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.armor_: Find the seam. A creature struck by Keen Strike suffers Weakness II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.perfec: There is no sharper blade. Keen Strike spends all your Edge and deals 1 more damage for each 10 spent. Sharpen Arms gives Strength II to everyone. Your hits build no Edge while Sharpen Arms lasts.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.sharpe: Every blade in the village, keen. You and allies within 6 blocks gain Strength for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.field_: A forge wherever you stand. You repair the weapon of the ally you are aiming at.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.warban: Blades up, together. Allies within 3 blocks of you gain Strength II from Sharpen Arms.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.master: A champion's weapon, for everyone. Field Forge reaches every ally within 8 blocks with no aim, and Whet needs no grindstone. Each use costs your own weapon 25 durability.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.edge_a: The edge meets the cut squarely. With at least 25 Edge, your swords and axes lose durability a quarter as often.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.fit_th: Made for that hand. Field Forge also removes the weapon's added anvil cost from earlier repairs.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.whet.d: Sparks, then a glint. At a grindstone, your hits deal 2 more damage for 60 seconds.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.honer.share_: Line up, blades out. Whet also repairs the weapons of allies within 6 blocks.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.fin: End it cleanly. Attacks deal 50% more damage to creatures below 30% health.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.cle: A clean stroke spares the edge. Swords and axes you use lose durability half as often.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.sme: You know when it is almost over. Creatures below 30% health within 16 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.exe: No mercy. With at least 25 Edge, attacks deal double damage to creatures below 30% health.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.cle: One heavy swing. You strike the creature you aim at. Below 30% health it takes heavy damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.hea: Clean and final. Cleave Through also hits the creatures on either side of its target.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.exe: It's over. Below 30% health, the creature you aim at takes massive damage. Above 30%, nothing happens and the Edge is spent.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.fin: The sentence is carried out. Cleave Through and Execute hit every creature below 30% health within 5 blocks. Against creatures above 30% they deal no damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.dre: They know what you are. When Execute kills, hostile creatures within 8 blocks flee from you for 4 seconds.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.sen: Marked for the block. Your bonuses against wounded creatures apply to a judged creature below 40% health.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.gri: Not before they do. With at least 50 Edge, you cannot drop below 1 health while a creature below 30% health is within 4 blocks.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.fel: One cut, the whole trunk. With an axe, you cut the log you aim at and every log above it.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.tim: Look out below. When Fell brings a tree down, hostile creatures within 4 blocks of you take 4 damage.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.jud: Weigh what is left of them. The creature you aim at glows for 20 seconds, and you read its health whenever you look at it.
skill.townstead.weaponsmith.headsman.hea: More head, less haste. With an axe, your attacks deal 30% more damage and Fell cuts the whole tree. Your axe swings 20% slower.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.well_kept_tool: A tool cared for lasts. Every minute, the tool in your hand recovers a little durability.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.stone_b: Stone gives way. You break stone and ore 30% faster.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.tunnel_: At home in the dark. Underground, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.rock_sp: Nothing is too hard. With at least 25 Knack, you break stone and ore twice as fast.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.mountai: Mountains are just slow rocks. With at least 50 Knack, you gain Haste II underground.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.bore.de: Drive the tunnel. With a pickaxe, you break the stone in a 3 by 3 area around the block you aim at.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.shaft.d: Straight in, whatever is in the way. Bore also breaks dirt, gravel and sand in its area.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.great_e: A cavern by lunch. Bore breaks a 5 by 5 area and Vein follows up to 8 touching blocks. Both cost your pickaxe twice the durability.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.cave_in: Bring the ceiling down on them. Hostile creatures within 5 blocks take 4 damage and suffer Slowness for 5 seconds.

skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.vein.de: Follow the seam. With a pickaxe, you break the ore you aim at and up to 3 touching blocks of the same ore.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.clean_s: Nothing left on the floor. Blocks broken by Vein go straight to your pack.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.dust_up: They cannot fight what they cannot see. Cave-In also blinds for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.undermi: The ground gives way. The creature you aim at sinks to the knees and cannot move or jump for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.backfil: Fill it in. A creature held by Undermine at half health or less takes 2 damage every second.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.delver.deep_dw: The deep answers you. Below sea level, Cave-In and Undermine are twice as strong. Above it, they do nothing.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.handy.d: Always something useful in your pockets. With a tool in hand, you break wood 15% faster.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.well_ma: A good worker is easy on the tools. Anvils you use never take damage.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.self_re: It fixes itself, mostly. The tool in your hand recovers a little durability every 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.master_: Bigger springs. Grappling Line throws you half again as far, and Spring Pad lasts 60 seconds and launches higher. Each use costs 10 Knack more.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.spring_: A spring in your step, literally. With at least 25 Knack, you jump one block higher.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.grappli: Hook and haul. You fling yourself forward and up.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.flash_p: Don't look at it. You blind hostile creatures within 8 blocks for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.contrap: It works, don't ask how. Flash Powder blinds for 8 seconds, and Spring Trap on a blinded creature launches every blinded creature within 4 blocks. Each use costs 10 Knack more.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.jury_ri: Wire, wax and hope. With at least 50 Knack, a tool in your hand below a tenth of its durability recovers 5 durability every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.haul.de: The line works both ways. While you sneak, Grappling Line pulls the ally you aim at to you instead.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.spring_: Step on it and see. You set a pad at your feet for 30 seconds. Anything that steps on it is launched up and forward.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.conveyo: A soft way down is half the trip. Anything launched by Spring Pad also falls slowly for 4 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.smoke_a: Gone before they blink. When Flash Powder blinds at least one creature, you gain Speed II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.spring_: Up you go. The creature you aim at is launched into the air.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tinker.clockwo: Timed to the landing. A creature launched by Spring Trap takes 4 more damage as it comes down and is slowed for 6 seconds.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.blast_h: Used to the noise. You take 50% less damage from explosions.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.blast_m: You know how to run a fire white-hot. Blast furnaces within 3 blocks of you smelt 25% faster.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.shock_a: Crouch and let it pass. While you sneak, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.demolit: Master of the controlled blast. With at least 50 Knack, you take no damage from explosions.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.firecra: A small bang to scatter them. You set off a small blast at the creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away. It deals up to 8 damage and does not break blocks.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.shaped_: Aimed and timed. You stick a charge on the creature you aim at. It goes off 2 seconds later, deals up to 15 damage and does not break blocks.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.chain_r: One goes, the next goes. Firecracker passes a smaller blast to one creature beside its target.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.grand_d: Stand well back. Blasting Charge breaks a 7 by 7 area, and Rocket Jump throws nearby creatures into the air too. Both now hurt you for 4.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.minefie: Every step is a gamble. Firecracker and Shaped Charge are set at your feet as mines. A mine waits up to 30 seconds and goes off when a hostile creature comes within 2 blocks. They no longer go off at once.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.short_f: Trim it close. With at least 25 Knack, your Shaped Charge goes off 1 second sooner when you set it while sneaking.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.blastin: Clear the face. You blast the stone in a 5 by 5 area around the block you aim at. Nothing it breaks drops.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.directe: A small charge, well placed. While you sneak, Blasting Charge breaks a 3 by 3 area and everything drops.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.rocket_: Do not try this at home. You set a charge under your feet. It launches you high and does not hurt you.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.sapper.soft_la: Knees bent. You take no fall damage for 10 seconds after Rocket Jump.
It is not coming off. A creature with a Shaped Charge glows and is slowed until it goes off.
skill.townstead.toolsmith.tool_belt.desc: The right tool is always at hand. What you hold swaps with the item in your pack that breaks the block you aim at fastest, up to 6 blocks away.
skill.townstead.mason.sure_hands.descrip: A mason's hands know stone. You break stone 20% faster.
skill.townstead.mason.shore.description: Prop it up. You set a stone prop in the open space in front of your feet. It holds for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.solid_: Stone walls keep you safe. Beside a wall or inside a building, you gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.load_b: You hold the house up. Beside a wall or inside a building, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.safe_h: Everyone by the wall is safe. With at least 25 Mortar, allies within 4 blocks of you who stand beside a wall gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.citade: No stone falls on your watch. With at least 50 Mortar, Safe House gives Resistance II instead.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.bolt_t: Everyone inside. Every open door within 8 blocks closes.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.sanctu: The walls protect their own. Creatures hit by Murder Hole are slowed and glow for 4 seconds, and Hold Fast lasts twice as long. In the open, with no wall beside you, both reach half as far.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.garris: Every building a fort. Allies under Hold Fast return 2 damage to creatures that hit them.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.unbrok: The village will not fall. Bolt the Door reaches 16 blocks and Brace the Beams spares 24 damage. Each use costs 10 Mortar more.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.thresh: Not through here. While you stand in a doorway or a gap 1 block wide, hostile creatures within 2 blocks are pushed back.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.bar_th: And the back way too. Bolt the Door also shuts fence gates and trapdoors.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.brace_: Props under every beam. You and allies within 6 blocks gain a ward that spares 12 explosion damage for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.fire_b: Nothing here burns. Brace the Beams also puts out fire on those it covers and every fire within 6 blocks.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.murder: Rocks from above. Stones drop on hostile creatures within 4 blocks of you for 4 damage. A creature in a doorway or a gap 1 block wide takes 8.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.boilin: Then the cauldron. Creatures hit by Murder Hole also burn for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.stonewarden.hold_f: Backs to the wall. You and allies within 6 blocks who stand beside a wall gain Resistance II for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.trowel_han: Stone goes up fast in your hands. You break stone 30% faster.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.behind_sto: Stone is the best armor. You take 30% less damage from projectiles.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.siege_mind: Think like a wall. With at least 25 Mortar, the stone you raise lasts twice as long.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.battlement: Fight from the wall. Arrows you fire from within 2 blocks of your raised stone deal 25% more damage.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.master_bui: The ground makes room. With at least 50 Mortar, stone you raise pushes hostile creatures within 3 blocks of you away.
Stone between you and them. A pillar of stone 2 blocks high rises in front of you for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.breastwork: A wall to hide behind. Barricade is 3 blocks wide and 3 high.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.redoubt.de: Wall yourself in. A ring of stone walls rises 2 blocks out around you for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.sally_fort: Out of the gate. When Redoubt rises, hostile creatures within 3 blocks are thrown out of it.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.scaffold.d: Up, and look around. A stone pillar 3 blocks high rises under you for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.ladder.des: Room for the crew. Scaffold also lifts allies within 2 blocks on pillars of their own.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.footbridge: A road where there was none. A stone bridge 5 blocks long rises ahead of you at foot level for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.span.descr: Further than they thought. Footbridge is 9 blocks long.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.masons_mar: Signed work stays. Scaffold and Footbridge stand for 5 minutes. Each use costs 10 Mortar more.
skill.townstead.mason.rampart.keep.descr: Built to be the last thing standing. Barricade and Redoubt rise 1 block taller and stand for 60 seconds. Each use costs 10 Mortar more.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.paved_w: Good roads, fast feet. On a road or path, you gain Speed.
You never trip on a curb. You can step up full blocks without jumping.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.highway: Everyone travels faster on your roads. With at least 25 Mortar, allies within 8 blocks who stand on a road or path gain Speed.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.all_roa: All roads lead home. With at least 50 Mortar, you gain Speed II on a road or path.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.road_ru: Open road ahead. You dash 6 blocks. On a road or path, the dash goes twice as far.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.tollgat: Nobody passes without leave. You chalk a patch of ground 5 blocks wide ahead of you for 15 seconds. Hostile creatures on it suffer Slowness II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.waystat: Rest by the road. Allies within 6 blocks of your Signpost lose Slowness and Hunger.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.road_pa: Keep the roads safe. On a road or path, a Tollgate lasts 5 minutes and Road Run costs no Mortar. Off a road, both cost twice as much.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.kings_h: The road belongs to everyone. Pave runs 15 blocks, and you and allies on a road within 6 blocks of your Signpost gain Speed II. Off a road, you move 10% slower.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.sure_ro: Good stone under your feet. On a road or path, Slowness does not hold you.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.pave.de: A road is a promise. With a shovel, the dirt in a line 5 blocks ahead of you becomes path.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.wide_ro: Room for a cart. Pave is 3 blocks wide and clears grass and flowers above it.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.signpos: This way. You set a signpost for 10 minutes: a column of light that anyone can see from afar.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.toll.de: Everybody pays. Creatures on a Tollgate also take 3 damage every second and glow.
skill.townstead.mason.roadwright.runaway: No brakes. Creatures in the path of Road Run are bowled aside.
skill.townstead.fletcher.archers_eye.des: Eyes made for the long shot. At night with a bow in hand, you gain Night Vision.
skill.townstead.fletcher.quick_shot.desc: Nock and loose. You fire an arrow where you are looking.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.spotte: Nothing moves out there without you seeing it. With a bow in hand, hostile creatures in front of you within 24 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.steady: Breathe out, then loose. With a bow in hand while standing still, you cannot be knocked back.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.hawkey: You see them before they see you. With at least 25 Draw, you gain Night Vision and hostile creatures within 32 blocks in front of you glow.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.legend: They tell stories about your shots. With at least 50 Draw and a bow in hand, your arrows deal 25% more damage.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.double: Two arrows, one draw. You fire two arrows where you are looking.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.spread: Fan them out. While you sneak, Double Shot fires five arrows in a fan.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.headsh: Right between the eyes. With a bow, one heavy shot at the creature you aim at, up to 32 blocks away, for 10 damage. A creature that glows takes 15.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.deadey: Never missed. Headshot reaches 48 blocks and deals 12 damage, or 15 to a creature that glows, and Double Shot fires three arrows that fly true. Within 8 blocks, Headshot deals a third of that.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.windag: You read the wind before you loose. Your arrows deal 10% more damage.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.range_: Pick one out of the crowd. The creature you look at, up to 32 blocks away, glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.read_t: How much is left in it. Range Finder also shows the creature's health.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.signal: Here. A beam of light rises where you stand for 60 seconds. Anyone can see it from afar.
It lights what stands near it. Hostile creatures within 8 blocks of a Signal Arrow glow.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.overwa: You watch the whole field. Range Finder also marks every creature within 8 blocks of its target, and a Signal Arrow lasts 5 minutes. Each use costs 10 Draw more.
skill.townstead.fletcher.marksman.throug: It does not stop at the first. Headshot hits every hostile creature in its line.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.light_f: You never trip your own traps. Cobwebs, berry bushes, and powder snow never slow you.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.game_tr: You know the forest paths. In a forest, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.apex_tr: Nothing escapes your ground. With at least 50 Draw, your hits deal double damage to a creature that took your Bait or tripped your wire.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.grand_t: The whole valley is a trap. A log drops for 8 damage on a creature struck by Ambush, and Deadfall drops on every creature within 16 blocks that took your Bait or tripped your wire. Deadfall no longer takes aim.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.scent_m: Mud and leaves hide your smell. Creatures drawn to your Bait ignore you.
Strike from hiding. Your next hit within 5 seconds deals double damage.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.flush_o: Drive them into the traps. A creature struck by Ambush runs from you for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.patienc: The longer you wait, the harder it lands. While you stand still, you slowly build up Strength, up to Strength II.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.camoufl: Mud, leaves, and stillness. With at least 25 Draw, while you sneak among leaves or tall grass, hostile creatures do not notice you.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.bait.de: They cannot help themselves. You set bait at your feet for 10 seconds. Animals and hostile creatures within 12 blocks go for it.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.tripwir: Mind your step. You string a wire 5 blocks wide across the ground 2 blocks ahead of you for 30 seconds. A hostile creature that crosses it is held for 3 seconds and glows, and a bell rings.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.bell_li: Set it and walk away. A wire lasts 5 minutes.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.traplin: A whole valley of them. Bait draws creatures from 24 blocks, and Tripwire is 9 blocks wide. Each use costs 10 Draw more.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.deadfal: Look up. A log drops on the creature you aim at 1 second later, for 8 damage. It deals 15 to a creature that took your Bait or tripped your wire.
skill.townstead.fletcher.trapper.counter: It stays where it falls. Deadfall also pins its target for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.ligh: Never stand still. With a bow in hand, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.stru: A well-set string lasts longer. Bows and crossbows you use lose durability half as often.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.evas: Hard to hit. With at least 25 Draw, you take 40% less damage from projectiles.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.wind: Faster than the wind. With at least 50 Draw and a bow in hand, you gain Speed II and Jump Boost II.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.vaul: Over their heads. From the ground, you leap forward and high into the air and fall slowly for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.shoo: Loose, then leave. You fire three arrows and leap backward.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.whir: Everywhere at once. Shoot and Scoot fires five arrows and Covering Fire fires twelve. Each use costs 10 Draw more.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.cove: Go, I'll cover you. Over 3 seconds, you fire eight arrows where you are looking.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.harr: They never see where it came from. Vault can be used in the air, and Vault and Tumble each leave you with Speed II for 3 seconds. Each use costs 10 Draw more.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.nimb: You land like a cat. You take no fall damage from less than 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.wall: A wall is a second floor. A Vault that starts beside a wall goes much higher.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.tumb: Roll with it. A dash of 5 blocks that clears the fall you were in. You take no fall damage for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.slid: Under the swing. During Tumble, hits against you are spared.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.part: The best shots are taken leaving. Arrows you fire while in the air deal 50% more damage.
skill.townstead.fletcher.skirmisher.supp: Heads down. The creature you aim at with Covering Fire and those within 6 blocks of it suffer Slowness II and Weakness for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.librarian.well_read.desc: Books have taught you patience. While standing still in a building, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.com: The complete work. With at least 50 Focus, identified creatures within 16 blocks glow and suffer Weakness.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.kno: Read them like a book. For 15 seconds, the creature you aim at glows and takes 25% more damage from you.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.wea: Page 214, the soft spot. With at least 25 Focus, your first hit on an unhurt identified creature deals 50% more damage.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.exp: And it knows you know. The creature under Know Thy Enemy also suffers Weakness.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.fin: One subject, studied to the end. What Cite does to a creature under Know Thy Enemy lasts twice as long. While Know Thy Enemy lasts, every other creature deals 25% more damage to you.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.gre: Every shelf in your head. A creature you Identify stays identified for 30 minutes, and Reference reaches 12 blocks before Spoor. Both work only while you stand still.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.bes: You have read about this one. Your attacks deal 25% more damage to creatures you identified.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.mar: You always write it down. You gain 25% more experience.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.cro: See also. Every 5 seconds, hostile creatures within 6 blocks of an identified creature become identified.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.ide: You have seen this page before. The creature you aim at glows for 10 seconds, you read its health, and it is identified for 5 minutes.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.hab: You know how it lives. You read the health of an identified creature whenever you look at it.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.ref: It is all cataloged. You learn each kind of container and machine within 8 blocks: how many, and how far the nearest one is. Nothing is spent if there is none.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.spo: A wider index. Reference reaches twice as far.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.cit: Chapter and verse. The creature you aim at takes 4 damage. An identified creature suffers what its kind fears instead: undead burn, creepers and endermen are held, spiders are netted, witches are stripped and weakened, raiders drop their weapon.
skill.townstead.librarian.lorekeeper.foo: See the others. Cite also reaches every hostile creature within 6 blocks of its target.
Unbound
No curse holds you. Every 10 seconds, Curse of Binding is removed from the armor you are wearing.
Unfading
What is yours stays yours. Every 10 seconds, Curse of Vanishing is removed from your armor and the items in your hands.
Warded
Magic slides off you. With at least 25 Focus, you take 40% less damage from magic.
Antimagic
Spells cannot find you. With at least 50 Focus, Poison, Wither, and Weakness are cleared from you every 2 seconds.
Break Binding
Let me see that helmet. You remove Curse of Binding and Curse of Vanishing from the gear of the ally you are aiming at.
Mass Uncursing
Everyone's gear, cleansed. Break Binding also reaches allies within 8 blocks of the one you aim at.
Purity

Nothing clings to you. Break Binding also cleanses your own gear and removes the added anvil cost of what it cleanses. The Dispel Field follows you, strips hostile creatures only, and strips your own helpful effects too.
Nullify
No more tricks. You strip every effect from hostile creatures within 6 blocks.
Silence
Not another word. Creatures hit by Nullify also suffer Weakness II for 5 seconds.
Counterspell
I know that one. You strip every effect from the creature you aim at. For 10 seconds, each hit it lands on you also deals the same damage to it.
Ward
A circle of chalk. When you cast Counterspell, you and allies within 6 blocks gain a ward that spares 8 magic damage for 10 seconds.
Sanctum Arcana
Every spell is a lesson. You gain 10 Focus for each creature that Nullify or Counterspell strips. You take double damage from magic.
Bookish
You know how books go together. Combining enchanted books at an anvil does not raise their repair cost.
Dispel Field
No magic here. For 20 seconds, every status effect is stripped each second from anyone within 8 blocks of where you stood.
Exemption
The rules have a margin. Allies inside the Dispel Field lose only their harmful effects.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.soft_step: Library shoes. Your footsteps make no vibrations, so sculk sensors and wardens do not hear you walk.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.quiet_hab: Even your lunch is silent. Eating, drinking, and swimming make no vibrations.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.shadow_re: You read in the dark, and nobody knows you are there. With at least 25 Focus, you are invisible while you sneak. Drains 1 Focus every second.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.unnoticed: They look right past you. With at least 50 Focus, hostile creatures ignore you while you sneak. Drains 3 Focus every second while a hostile creature is within 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.fade.desc: Between the shelves. You become invisible for 8 seconds, or until you attack.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.vanishing: Look over there. When you Fade, you leave a puff of dust that hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.unseen_sc: Nobody remembers seeing you. Fade lasts until you attack or your Focus runs out, and drains 4 Focus every second. For 8 seconds after Blackout, it drains nothing. Your attacks always deal half damage.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.quiet_roo: Everybody, very quiet. You and allies within 6 blocks become invisible for 10 seconds.
Lights out. Hostile creatures within 10 blocks suffer Blindness and Darkness for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.great_sil: Not a sound in the whole wing. Quiet Room covers 12 blocks, and Hold Breath lasts 40 seconds. Each use costs 10 Focus more.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.light_fin: Not a creak. Opening and closing chests and doors makes no vibrations, and piglins ignore you.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.whisper.d: Quieter still. Quiet Room lasts 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.hold_brea: Not a sound, not a breath. For 20 seconds, hostile creatures farther than 4 blocks from you do not notice you.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.feather_s: You land like a turned page. During Hold Breath, you take no fall damage.
skill.townstead.librarian.hush.lights_ou: And the candles. Blackout also puts out campfires and candles within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.librarian.look_it_up.des: It is in here somewhere. You learn the name of the block you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, and how far it is.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanned_han: Hands like leather. You are immune to Hunger.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.go: You never fall off. While riding, you take half damage from falling.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.st: A calm rider makes a calm horse. While you ride, your mount takes 20% less damage.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.sw: Your horse flies. With at least 25 Hide, your mount gains Speed while you ride.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.wa: A mount fit for a knight. With at least 50 Hide, your mount gains Speed II and takes 40% less damage while you ride.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.le: Over the fence. Sure-Footed gives Jump Boost III.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.ch: Lances down! Your mount gains a burst of speed, and hostile creatures within 4 blocks are knocked aside. On foot, you dash 4 blocks and knock aside what you pass.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.ba: Armor for the horse. Your mount gains a ward that spares 12 damage for 15 seconds. On foot, the ward is yours.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.ca: Ride together. The mounts of allies who ride within 12 blocks charge with you and share your Barding. Charge and Barding cost twice as much.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.ho: Every horse answers to you. Whistle Up reaches 96 blocks, and Sure-Footed lasts 60 seconds. On foot, you move 10% slower.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.sa: Room for the road. You gain saddlebags with 9 slots of extra storage, opened with an ability key.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.wh: One whistle, and hooves. Your tamed horses, donkeys, mules, camels and llamas within 48 blocks come to you.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.hi: Stay. While you sneak, Whistle Up tells your mounts within 8 blocks to stand still for 60 seconds, with a ward that spares 20 damage.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.su: Any ground is good ground. For 30 seconds, your mount jumps higher, falls slowly and swims fast. On foot, the effects are yours.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.ri: Do not stop for them. Creatures struck by Charge take 5 damage and fall.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.saddler.re: It will not go quietly. When the Barding ward breaks, hostile creatures within 3 blocks are knocked back.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.sup: Leather moves with you. Wearing a leather chestplate, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.har: Well-stitched leather mends quickly. At an anvil, each leather you use repairs 50% of your leather armor's durability instead of 25%.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.boi: Hard as wood. With at least 25 Hide and a leather chestplate, you take 25% less damage.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.hid: Leather that stops a blade. With at least 50 Hide and a leather chestplate, you gain Resistance II.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.whi: Back! You strike hostile creatures in an arc within 6 blocks for 3 damage and push them back. A creature at the tip takes 6.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.las: A sting they will remember. Whip Crack also drags the creature you aim at within 8 blocks toward you, and it can barely strike for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.cat: Nine tails, nine stings. Whip Crack strikes three times, and Whirl lasts 6 seconds. Your whip tools work only with an empty off hand.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.whi: A longer lash. Whip Crack, Snatch and Whirl reach 2 blocks farther.
Catch a beam and go. Under a roof, a branch or a ledge, you swing forward and up.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.let: Land running. You take no fall damage for 5 seconds after Whip Swing.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.sna: Yours now. You pull the dropped item you aim at to you from up to 8 blocks away. With a lever or a button within reach, you flip the one you aim at instead.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.lon: Further than they thought. Snatch reaches 16 blocks.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.bul: It bites. Whip Swing also yanks the hostile creature you aim at toward you, and Snatch also disarms the hostile creature you aim at. Each whip tool costs 5 Hide more.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.whi: Nothing gets close. For 3 seconds the whip spins over your head. Hostile creatures within 3 blocks are pushed back, and projectiles do you no harm.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.tanner.sti: The lash has an edge. A creature pushed back by Whirl takes 2 damage and falls.
Satchel
A good bag goes everywhere. You gain a satchel with 27 slots of extra storage, opened with an ability key.
Pack Mule
A heavy load never slows you. You are immune to Slowness.
Well Supplied
Always packed right. With at least 25 Hide, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
Waterproof Pack
Nothing is ever lost. If you die with at least 50 Hide, you keep your inventory.
Bedroll
A nap anywhere. You recover a large amount of energy, and your respawn point is set here.
Canteen
Water for the road. You recover a little thirst every 10 seconds.
Expedition Kit
Everything, and the weight of it. Pitons drain no stamina while no hostile creature is within 16 blocks, and Bedroll clears your harmful effects. You walk 10% slower.
Grand Outfitter
A spare of everything. Fall Back leaves a pack that hostile creatures within 8 blocks attack for 4 seconds, and the Emergency Kit ward spares 12 damage. Each use costs 10 Hide more.
Pitons
Iron in the rock, one step at a time. While held, you can climb walls. Drains 3 stamina every second.
Belay
The rope holds. While Pitons are held, you take no fall damage.
Base Camp
Room for everyone. Players within 8 blocks also set their respawn point at the Bedroll and recover energy.
Fall Back
Not today. You and allies within 10 blocks leap backward.
Cover Our Tracks
They lose a step. When you Fall Back, hostile creatures within 8 blocks are slowed for 3 seconds.
Emergency Kit
I've got you. The ally you aim at is pulled to you, loses fire and harmful effects, and gains a ward that spares 6 damage for 10 seconds.
Stretcher
On my back. The rescued ally rides on your back for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.leatherworker.sling.desc: A strap and a stone. You strike the creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, for 2 damage.
Out in all weathers. Cold and heat affect your body half as much.
skill.townstead.climatologist.frostkeepe: Cold Blooded
The cold is home. Cold no longer affects your body temperature.
Powder Walker
You walk on snow like it is stone. Powder snow never slows you.
Frostbite
Cold hands. Your hits freeze creatures.
Winter's Heart
The cold goes where you go. With at least 50 Front, hostile creatures within 6 blocks slowly freeze.
Cold Snap
A breath of winter. Hostile creatures within 5 blocks are chilled and slowed. A wet creature freezes solid for 3 seconds.
Hoarfrost
Frozen things break. Your hit on a creature frozen solid shatters the ice for 6 more damage.
Deep Winter
It does not thaw. Ice from Ice Bridge stays, and Snowfall covers 8 blocks. Fire hurts you twice as much.
Ice Wall
Winter, standing up. A wall of ice rises in front of you for 15 seconds.
Ice Ring
All the way around. While you sneak, Ice Wall rises as a ring around you.
Glacier
It does not stop. Ice Wall shoves hostile creatures within 4 blocks away and chills them, and Cold Snap reaches 8 blocks. Cold Snap freezes you in place for 1 second too.
Black Ice
You know where to put your feet. With at least 25 Front, on ice or snow you gain Speed and cannot be knocked back.
Ice Bridge
The water holds for you. For 20 seconds, water freezes under your feet as you walk.
Snow Shoes
A longer crossing. Ice Bridge lasts 40 seconds.
Snowfall
A quiet white. Snow settles on the ground within 4 blocks of where you aim. Fires there go out, and water freezes over.
Hard Frost
It bites. Snowfall also chills and slows hostile creatures within 6 blocks of you.
skill.townstead.climatologist.heatwarden: Warm Blooded
The heat is home. Heat no longer affects your body temperature.
Heatproof
You barely feel the burn. You take half damage from fire.
Kindle
A spark, wherever you look. You light the campfire, furnace or candle you aim at, up to 12 blocks away. Aimed at anything else, you set fire on top of it.
Searing Touch
Hot hands. Your hits set creatures on fire.
Living Flame
You are the fire. With at least 50 Front, you are immune to fire, and hostile creatures within 4 blocks catch fire.
Flare
A burst of heat. You set hostile creatures within 4 blocks on fire for 3 seconds.
Heat Wave
It spreads. Creatures within 2 blocks of one that Flare sets alight catch fire too.
Wildfire
It jumps. Sunstroke on a burning creature also sets fire to creatures within 3 blocks of it.
Inferno
Nothing puts it out. Flare burns for 10 seconds, and Sunstroke sets a burning creature alight again for 10 seconds. While you are wet, you take 1 damage every second.
Mirage
Hard to aim through. Anyone inside the Heat Haze takes half damage from projectiles.
Sunstroke
Too long in the sun. The creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, is weakened, slowed and sick for 10 seconds. A burning creature is blinded as well.
Solar Flare
The sun does as you ask. Kindle also sets a line of fire 5 blocks long ahead of you, and the Heat Haze burns hostile creatures in it. In rain, neither tool works.
Kiln
You keep it hot. With at least 25 Front, furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers within 3 blocks work 25% faster.
Thaw
Winter lets go. Kindle also melts snow and ice within 3 blocks of the block you aim at.
Heat Haze
The air stands up. A column of hot air rises where you stand for 20 seconds. Anything in it is lifted gently upward.
skill.townstead.climatologist.stormcalle: Storm Sense
You feel it coming. In rain or thunder, you gain Speed.
Grounded
Lightning finds its way around you. You take 75% less damage from lightning.
Tempest
The storm is yours. With at least 25 Front during thunder, you gain Strength and Speed II.
Eye of the Storm
Calm at the center. With at least 50 Front, lightning does not hurt you.
Lightning Strike
Out of a clear sky. Lightning strikes the creature you aim at, up to 32 blocks away. Under a roof, a static arc deals 6 damage instead.
Gust
A wall of air. Hostile creatures within 5 blocks are pushed away, and for 2 seconds projectiles do you no harm.
Tailwind
Lean into it. For 10 seconds, a wind pushes you and allies within 8 blocks forward once every second.
Squall
The wind finds what is loose. Gust throws wet or airborne creatures twice as far.
Hurricane
The storm of the century. Gust blows for 5 seconds, and Lightning Strike strikes three times. You are lifted off the ground and can barely move for 5 seconds.
Static
It jumps. In rain, each hit you land also arcs to one creature within 3 blocks of your target for 1 damage.
Weather Vane
The sky takes a hint. You change the weather one step: clear to rain, rain to thunder, thunder to clear. It needs 50 Front and spends it.
Fair or Foul
You choose. While you sneak, Weather Vane always clears the sky.
Gale
Enough to fly on. Tailwind also gives Slow Falling to those it carries.
Stormbringer
The sky answers at once. Weather Vane needs and spends only 25 Front, and Tailwind lasts 20 seconds. Each change of weather calls lightning down where you stand.
Chain
Water carries it. The strike arcs to wet creatures within 6 blocks of its target for 6 damage.
skill.townstead.climatologist.forecast.d: Read the sky. You learn what the weather is and how long it lasts.
skill.townstead.tailor.layered.descripti: Always dressed for the weather. Cold and heat affect your body 30% less.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.sharp_shea: Shears are a weapon in the right hands. Attacks with shears deal triple damage.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.keen_shear: Sharp shears never dull. Shears you use lose no durability.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.measure_tw: Every cut counts. With at least 25 Stitch, Sew Up wards spare 2 more damage, and allies within 8 blocks keep a ward that spares 1 damage.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.master_cut: No cloth or hide resists you. With at least 50 Stitch, creatures you hit with shears suffer Weakness II for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.thousand_s: Faster than the eye can follow. Snip strikes three times, and Sew Up also wards allies within 6 blocks of its target. Each use costs 10 Stitch more.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.sew_up.des: Stitch the wound shut. The ally you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, gains a ward that spares 8 damage for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.darn.descr: Patched again. A Sew Up ward that breaks forms again once, sparing 4 damage for 15 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.bespoke.de: Made to measure. Mend repairs 40 durability, and Shear Clean reaches 12 blocks. Each use costs 10 Stitch more.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.thimble.de: A small thing between you and the point. You take 10% less damage.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.shear_clea: The whole flock in one pass. With shears in your pack, you shear every ready animal within 4 blocks. The wool goes to your pack.
Room for more. Shear Clean reaches 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.mend.descr: Good as new, nearly. You repair each armor piece worn by the ally you aim at, up to 6 blocks away, by 20 durability.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.invisible_: Nobody can tell. Mend also clears the anvil cost of the armor.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.snip.descr: One clean cut. You strike the creature you aim at for 3 damage, and it loses its beneficial effects.
skill.townstead.tailor.needle.thread_the: Straight through. Snip strikes every hostile creature in its line.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.spiders_st: Webs are just thread. Cobwebs never slow you.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.tangleweav: Everything you touch snags. Creatures you hit suffer Slowness for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.master_wea: The whole room is your loom. With at least 50 Stitch, your attacks deal 25% more damage to slowed creatures.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.web_of_sil: Your lines stay up. A Tightrope holds for 5 minutes, and Lifeline lasts 2 minutes. Each use costs 10 Stitch more.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.bind.descr: Wrapped tight. The creature you aim at, up to 12 blocks away, cannot walk for 4 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.cocoon.des: Wrapped from head to toe. The creature you aim at, up to 12 blocks away, cannot walk or strike for 5 seconds. While wrapped, it takes half damage.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.silk_shrou: It does not come off clean. When a Cocoon ends, the creature suffers Slowness II and Weakness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.loom_of_fa: Every thread, pulled at once. Bind and Cocoon hold for 8 seconds, and Bind also holds up to 3 hostile creatures within 6 blocks of you. While they hold, you suffer Slowness.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.spinner.de: Nothing goes to waste. Cobwebs you break by hand drop string.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.strong_thr: It does not give. With at least 25 Stitch, slowed hostile creatures within 6 blocks suffer Weakness.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.lifeline.d: Tie off before you climb. For 30 seconds, falls do not hurt you.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.belayer.de: You hold the other end. Lifeline also gives the ally you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, Slow Falling for 10 seconds.
One step at a time. You string a line of silk 8 blocks ahead of you, at the level of the ground you stand on, across open air. It holds for 60 seconds, and anyone can walk on it.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.zip_line.d: A longer reach. A Tightrope is 16 blocks long.
skill.townstead.tailor.weaver.stitch_tog: Two on one thread. Bind also holds one other hostile creature within 3 blocks of its target.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.winter_c: Wrapped warm. Cold affects your body 70% less.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.summer_l: Light and cool. Heat affects your body 70% less.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.dressed_: They never see it coming. With at least 25 Stitch, while you are disguised, hostile creatures within 4 blocks suffer Weakness.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.haute_co: It holds while it has to. With at least 50 Stitch, a disguise does not run out while a hostile creature is within 12 blocks. This costs 2 Stitch every second.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.disguise: Nobody looks twice at a zombie. You put on a zombie-head disguise for 20 seconds. While disguised, hostile creatures ignore you.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.quick_ch: A new face in a blink. When you use Disguise, hostile creatures within 12 blocks drop their target at once.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.masquera: Everyone in masks. Allies within 8 blocks put on masks, and hostile creatures within 8 blocks drop their target and stand still for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.master_o: Who? Disguise lasts 5 minutes, and Wardrobe also puts the disguise on. While disguised, your attacks deal half damage.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.grand_ma: The ball of the year. Masquerade reaches 16 blocks and holds for 6 seconds, and Wardrobe Malfunction also strikes hostile creatures within 4 blocks of its target. For 30 seconds after either, you glow and your disguise fools no one.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.fitted.d: Clothes that fit last longer. Armor you wear loses durability half as fast.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.wardrobe: Something for every occasion. Each armor piece you wear swaps with the first piece for the same slot in your pack.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.dress_th: They do not know you in that. When you use Wardrobe, hostile creatures within 8 blocks stand still for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.good_sea: It holds a little longer. Masquerade holds hostile creatures for 2 seconds more.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.wardrobe: A strap gives way. The creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, trips for 2 seconds. For 8 seconds, your attacks deal 50% more damage to it.
skill.townstead.tailor.clothier.emperors: Nobody can look away. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks of a Wardrobe Malfunction stand still for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.tailor.dye_job.descripti: A new color in one stroke. With dye in your pack, you dye the animal you aim at, up to 8 blocks away.
skill.townstead.witch.iron_stomach.descr: A witch tastes everything once. You are immune to Poison.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.evil_eye.des: Look what you did. Whatever hurts you is hexed for a minute.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.lingering_cu: The hex never lets go. Creatures you have hexed within 16 blocks are slowed every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.withering_he: It rots from inside. With at least 25 Hex, creatures you have hexed within 16 blocks suffer Wither every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.doom.descrip: Marked for the end. With at least 50 Hex, creatures you have hexed within 24 blocks glow and suffer Weakness II.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.hex.descript: A word, and it sticks. You hex the creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, for a minute. Aimed at a hexed creature, it strikes every creature you have hexed within 24 blocks for 3 damage.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.jinx.descrip: Nothing goes right for it. A creature you hex with Hex suffers Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.mass_hex.des: A curse on all your houses. You hex every hostile creature within 8 blocks for a minute.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.covens_curse: All of them, all at once. The Poppet lasts 40 seconds, reaches 24 blocks and deals 4 damage, and Scry reaches 128 blocks. While the Poppet lasts, you take 25% more damage.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.blight.descr: It takes root. Creatures hexed by Mass Hex suffer Wither for 6 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.reckoning.de: Every debt, paid at once. The strike from Hex deals 8 damage, and Mass Hex reaches 16 blocks. The strike ends the hex on every creature it hits.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.spite.descri: It does not die with them. When you kill a creature, the nearest hostile creature within 8 blocks is hexed.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.scry.descrip: You always know where they are. Every creature you have hexed within 64 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.second_sight: And how they are doing. Scry also shows each creature's health.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.poppet.descr: What is done to you is done to them. For 20 seconds, each time you are hurt, every creature you have hexed within 12 blocks takes 2 damage.
skill.townstead.witch.hexer.pins.descrip: One for each joint. A creature the Poppet hurts also suffers Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.poultice: Hold still. You and the ally you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, lose Poison, Wither and fire.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.antidote: You know every cure. You are immune to Wither and Nausea.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.herbal_a: The smell alone does it. With at least 25 Hex, Poison is cleared from you and allies within 8 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.wise_wom: She has seen worse. With at least 50 Hex, Wither, Hunger and Nausea are cleared from you and allies within 8 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.tonic.de: What ails you now helps you. Poultice turns Slowness into Speed and Weakness into Strength for 5 seconds.
One cure for everything, for everyone else. Poultice covers allies within 8 blocks and clears every harmful effect, and Smelling Salts also rouses allies within 8 blocks. Poison, Wither, Weakness, Slowness, Blindness, Nausea and Hunger last twice as long on you.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.nettle_s: It itches, then it burns. Hostile creatures within 4 blocks suffer Poison for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.toxic_cl: Do not breathe in. A cloud of miasma hangs around you, 3 blocks out, for 13 seconds. It poisons hostile creatures inside it.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.nightsha: Sleep now. A hostile creature at half health or less that Nettle Sting poisons drops its target and stands still for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.plague_g: Everything here is sick. Nettle Sting reaches 6 blocks and its Poison lasts 15 seconds, and Toxic Cloud reaches 6 blocks out. Both poison allies too.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.bitter_r: Chew this. When you are hurt at 30% health or less, you gain a ward that spares 4 damage for 10 seconds.
You know where it grows. Flowers, mushrooms, nether wart and berry bushes within 8 blocks glint every 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.smelling: Up you get. The ally you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, wakes up and loses Blindness, Darkness, Nausea, Slowness and Mining Fatigue.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.pick_me_: A little something in it. Someone you rouse with Smelling Salts also recovers energy.
skill.townstead.witch.herbalist.spores.d: It spreads. Toxic Cloud reaches 4 blocks out.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.light_a: Witches float. You take half damage from falling.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.broomst: Up, up, and away! For 30 seconds, you can fly outdoors at night. Flying costs 6 Hex every second. When it ends, the broom sets you down gently.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.sky_wit: The sky is yours. With at least 25 Hex, you fly 50% faster.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.take_of: Up we go. You leap high into the air and fall slowly for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.swoop.d: Down and through. You fly 10 blocks where you look. The first hostile creature in your way takes 4 damage and is thrown into the air.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.hex_bol: A curse with a point on it. You strike the creature you aim at, up to 24 blocks away, for 5 damage, and it suffers Weakness for 5 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.wild_hu: The whole coven rides. Take Off lifts allies within 8 blocks, and the Broomstick lasts 2 minutes. The broom no longer sets you down gently.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.witchin: The hour belongs to you. With at least 50 Hex, within an hour of midnight, you gain 5 Hex every second.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.coven_n: The night is full of wings. Cast from the air, Hex Bolt also strikes up to 2 hostile creatures within 4 blocks of its target, and Swoop throws up to 3. On the ground, both cost twice as much.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.moon_ph: The full moon is yours. Outdoors at night under a full moon, you gain 3 more Hex every second.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.cats_lu: Nine lives, give or take. Once every 5 minutes, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.side_sa: Room for one more. Take Off also lifts allies within 3 blocks.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.low_fly: Keep your head down. By day or under a roof, the Broomstick still flies within 3 blocks of the ground.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.bad_luc: It forgets what it was doing. A creature struck by Hex Bolt drops its target and stands still for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.witch.broomrider.from_on: It is the landing that hurts. A creature thrown by Swoop takes 4 more damage a moment later.
skill.townstead.witch.brew_sense.descrip: You can smell what is in them. You read the effects on the creature you aim at, up to 16 blocks away, and how long each one lasts.
career.townstead.witch.description: A village herbalist and potion compounder who keeps exact remedies, volatile mixtures, and their consequences in careful custody.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chef_de_cuisin: The kitchen is yours. Pass reaches 24 blocks and Expedite reaches 12. You gain no Flow from the dishes you finish yourself.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chefs_knife.de: A practiced hand makes quick work of anything on the board. With a kitchen knife, hostile creatures in an arc in front of you take 4 damage.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.dinner_rush.de: Every order at once, and you love it. Each creature hurt by Chef's Knife or Hot Pan gives you 5 Flow. Both cost 10 stamina more.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.honed_edge.des: A well-kept knife never dulls on the board. Near a cutting board, your knives lose no durability.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.running_the_pa: You keep an eye on every station. In a kitchen with another Cook within 8 blocks, cooking stations within 6 blocks of you work 15% faster.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.plating.descri: A dish that looks right sits right. Status effects you gain last 50% longer, good and bad.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.family_meal.de: The crew eats first. With at least 25 Flow, status effects gained by allies within 6 blocks last 50% longer.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.in_the_weeds.d: Twenty tickets and you speed up. With at least 50 Flow, you gain Haste II in a kitchen.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.pass.descripti: Hands! You throw the item in your hand to the ally you aim at, up to 8 blocks away. It lands in their hand or pack.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.hands.descript: Already moving to the next plate. After a Pass, you gain Speed for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.expedite.descr: Fire everything. Every cooking station within 6 blocks jumps 10 seconds ahead in its current dish.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.all_day.descri: Nobody leaves the line. Expedite also gives energy back to other Cooks within 8 blocks.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.julienne.descr: Thin, even, twice. Chef's Knife deals double damage to a creature that is slowed.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.hot_pan.descri: Return to sender. With a skillet, for 2 seconds projectiles that would hit you are batted away, and whoever fired them takes that damage.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.sizzle.descrip: Touch the pan, learn the lesson. During Hot Pan, creatures that hit you in melee burn for 2 seconds.
Food tastes better outside. Outdoors within 4 blocks of a campfire, you recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.campfire_: You know where not to put your hands. You take half damage from fire.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.smoke_sig: They can see it from the hills. While you stand within 4 blocks of a campfire, a tall column of smoke rises from you.
Nothing you serve sits badly. With at least 25 Simmer, Hunger and Nausea are cleared from you and allies within 6 blocks every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.stone_sou: Enough for everyone. With at least 50 Simmer, within 4 blocks of a campfire, allies within 6 blocks recover energy every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.dinner_be: Come and get it. A bell rings, and allies within 24 blocks recover energy. You glow for 10 seconds so they can find you.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.seconds.d: There is always more. Dinner Bell also clears Hunger from the allies it reaches.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.hearthsid: Sit down a while. Within 4 blocks of a campfire, a warm ring 8 blocks wide stands where you are for 60 seconds. Allies inside it stop burning and lose Hunger, Weakness and Mining Fatigue.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.bedroll_c: Rest your feet. Allies inside a Hearthside ring also recover 1 health every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.camp_kitc: The whole camp eats. Dinner Bell reaches 48 blocks, and Hearthside is 12 blocks wide and lasts 2 minutes. Neither works under a roof.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.ladle.des: Out of my kitchen. You strike the creature you aim at for 3 damage. It drops its target and stands still for 2 seconds.
It was still boiling. A creature struck by Ladle takes 2 damage every second for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.kick_the_: Mind your feet. Boiling water spills ahead of you. Hostile creatures within 6 blocks in front of you take 4 damage and are pushed back.
It stays on the floor. The spill covers the ground 6 blocks ahead of you for 5 seconds. Hostile creatures in it suffer Slowness IV.
skill.townstead.cook.camp_cook.cast_iron: The pot makes a fine shield. For 5 seconds after Ladle or Kick the Pot, you take half damage. For 3 seconds after either, you suffer Slowness II.
skill.townstead.cook.order_up.descriptio: Hands! The dropped item you aim at, up to 8 blocks away, comes to you.
townstead.career.respec: Career skills changed in this update. Your skills were reset and all your Insight is free to spend again.
townstead_voice.mca.crabby.dialogue.chat: How am I supposed to fish with nothing, exactly?
Someone's taken my rod, haven't they. Hand one over.
Barrel's full. Should've thought of that, shouldn't we.
Fish everywhere, nowhere to put them. Planning, it's called planning.
Another chest. Today, preferably. I've had enough.
A fisherman with no water. What are we, a comedy?
You expect me to fish in the dirt? Find me a pond already.
Path's blocked. Who leaves things in the way like this?
I can't reach the water because someone couldn't be bothered to clean up.
Move whatever it is out of my way. Honestly.
townstead_voice.mca.flirty.dialogue.chat: Oh sweetheart, got a rod I could borrow? I promise I'll make it worth your while.
A girl needs her tackle, darling. Help a pretty thing out?
Come closer, love. I'd fish if I had a rod — know anyone who could lend me one?
My barrel's stuffed, darling, and not in the fun way.
Sweetie, I need somewhere to put my catch. Got room for me?
Cozy up a chest for me, love, my barrel's full to the brim.
Honey, all this talk of getting wet and not a drop of water in sight.
Sugar, I need water like you need sweet company. Help me out?
Find me a nice pond, handsome, and I'll do the rest.
Sugar, something's in my way and you know how I hate being stood up.
Darling, the path to my spot's a mess. Clear it for me?
Come sweep me a path, handsome, and I'll sweep you off your feet.
townstead_voice.mca.gloomy.dialogue.chat: No rod. Of course. Why would there be.
Empty hands, empty pack. Fitting, really.
A rod would help. Not that anyone's listening.
No room for the catch. No room for me, either, it seems.
The barrel rejects me. Even wood turns its back.
Everything's full except my heart. Another chest would help.
No water anywhere. Just like the warmth of friendship.
The pond's gone dry, or never was. Hard to say which is worse.
I need water. But I'll probably just stand here.
The path is blocked. Maybe it's a sign.
I can't reach the water. I can't reach much of anything, really.
Something's in the way. Feels fitting.
townstead_voice.mca.greedy.dialogue.chat: No rod, no fish, no profit. Fix it.
A rod is a tool. Tools make coin. Bring me one.
You want fish? Rods don't grow on trees. Well, technically...
Barrel's full. That's a good problem. Give me another.
Storage overflowing. More chests means more inventory means more profit.
Expand the operation. I need another container, now.
No water means no fish means no revenue. Unacceptable.
Dig me a pond, close by. Time is emeralds.
I need water. Preferably before my competitors get any.
Blocked path. That's lost revenue right there.
Can't reach the water, can't move product. Unacceptable.
Clear the way. Every minute I'm here costs us both.
townstead_voice.mca.odd.dialogue.chat.fi: The rod has gone. Perhaps it swam away.
No rod. The fish are relieved, I suspect.
A rod, a rod, my kingdom for a rod. Or half a rod. I'm flexible.
The barrel refuses further fish. It is a barrel with standards.
Too many fish, not enough box. A tale as old as time.
Another container, please. The fish have opinions about crowding.
The water has gone elsewhere. Perhaps a party.
Where there is no water, there are no fish. A profound insight.
I dreamed of a pond. Woke up. Still no pond. Please find one.
An invisible wall. Or a real one. Either way, unfortunate.
The path is a riddle today, and I do not have the answer.
Something blocks the way. Perhaps it is me. Perhaps it is geometry.
townstead_voice.mca.playful.dialogue.cha: Hey hey, no rod! Wanna go find me one? I'll do a little jig.
Psst — I'm rod-less over here! Rescue me?
No rod, no fish, no fun. Help a pal out!
Barrel's burstin'! Gonna start stuffing fish in my pockets.
I need another chest or these fish are going rogue!
Room for one more? Or ten more? Please?
Oh no, dry land as far as I can see! Pond, please?
Fish can't fly, last I checked. Got any water around?
Gimme a puddle, a pond, a bathtub — anything wet!
Road closed ahead! Send a hero to clear the way!
Something's blockin' the path. Tag, you're it!
Can't get to the water — obstacle course got me good.
townstead_voice.mca.relaxed.dialogue.cha: No rod on me. No worries, whenever you've got one.
Could use a rod. Take your time, I'll be here.
A rod would be nice. Plenty of time, friend.
Barrel's full. A spare chest anywhere around? No pressure.
My catch needs a home. I'll hold onto it 'til you sort one.
Whenever you get a moment, we could use another container.
No water to cast in. I'll wait 'til one turns up.
Point me at a pond, I'll take it from there. No rush.
Any water nearby? I'll just enjoy the quiet until you find one.
Path's a bit tricky today. Sort it when you can.
Can't quite reach the water. Nothing urgent, just a heads up.
Something's in the way. I'll wait it out.
combo_skill.townstead.charcutier.descrip: The butcher's block and the kitchen meet in cured meat. You gain 1 extra XP in both crafts whenever you complete work.
combo_skill.townstead.farm_to_table.desc: A cook's eye for what's ready. Ripe crops within 12 blocks of you give off a faint sparkle.
combo_skill.townstead.grain_to_loaf.desc: From the field to the oven, nothing goes to waste. Food eaten by anyone within 8 blocks of you restores 25% more hunger.
combo_skill.townstead.catch_of_the_day.d: You are what you eat. When you eat a fish, you gain Dolphin's Grace and Water Breathing for 30 seconds.
combo_skill.townstead.armory.description: Blade first, then the bow. For 5 seconds after you hit a creature with a sword or axe, your arrows deal 50% more damage.
combo_skill.townstead.apothecary.descrip: Every draught carries its own cure. When you drink a potion, harmful effects on you are cleared.
combo_skill.townstead.nose_to_tail.descr: You know every animal, inside and out. While you wear a leather chestplate, animals deal 25% less damage to you.
combo_skill.townstead.quarryman.descript: Stone is solid ground to you. On stone, you step up full blocks and gain Speed.
combo_skill.townstead.homespun.descripti: Wool breaks every fall. Landing on wool or hay never hurts you.
combo_skill.townstead.atlas.description: Read enough maps and you see further than the road. Maps you carry fill in twice as wide.
faction.townstead.village_council.descri: The council responsible for this village.
faction.townstead.hunter_order.descripti: An order of hunters sworn to a lodge. The Huntmaster leads, and every member is a hunter.
faction.townstead.player_faction.descrip: A faction founded at a Charter Bell and led by its leader.
faction.townstead.free_settlement.descri: The settlement shares a name and a place, but no one holds office.
townstead_voice.townstead.persona.villag: There you are. I was going to come and find you.
Oh, good. Got a minute? I've always got a minute.
I was just thinking about roofs. Don't ask.
You look like someone with a plan. Or a headache.
I'm listening. I'm also counting something, but I'm listening.
There you are. I was hoping I'd catch you.
Oh, good. You're the one everyone points at.
Hi. I've heard about you. Good things, mostly.
career.townstead.hunter.description: A sworn member of a hunter order who keeps the night watch and goes after what hunts the village.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.hunters_gr: A weapon held like it means it. You deal 1 more damage with every attack.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.stake_thru: Straight to the chest. The creature you aim at within 4 blocks takes 5 damage, or 9 if it is undead or a vampire.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.pounce.des: Close the gap. You dash 6 blocks and strike the first creature you reach for 6 damage.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.second_win: Hurt, not beaten. Below half health, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.heartseeke: Find the gap in the ribs. Stake Thrust also deals 9 damage to a slowed creature.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.harry.desc: Never let it settle. Pounce does not stop at the first creature: it strikes up to 3 in its path.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.no_quarter: Nothing walks away. Under a Vow, your quarry glows within 64 blocks, and you deal 50% more damage to it and 50% less to everything else.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.relentless: The hunt carries you. With at least 25 Vigil, you gain Strength.
Your blows burn what should be dead. With at least 50 Vigil, your attacks set undead creatures and vampires on fire.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.final_rite: The last words over the quarry. When Stake Thrust kills, hostile creatures within 8 blocks flee for 5 seconds, and a creature struck by Pounce is held for 2 seconds. Stake Thrust takes 1 second to land.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.stake_read: It will not get far. A creature you hit below 20% health suffers Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.fresh_trac: It went this way. The creature you aim at, up to 32 blocks away, glows for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.quarry.des: Never out of sight for long. You gain Speed while a creature you tracked is within 32 blocks.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.vow.descri: That one, and no other. You name the creature you aim at as your quarry for 5 minutes. You deal 25% more damage to it and 25% less to everything else.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.trophy.des: The vow is kept. When your quarry dies by your hand, you gain 50 Vigil and 50 stamina, and the Vow ends.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.home_gr: You know every street of it. Inside your village, you gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sprinkl: A splash of holy water. Holy water pools under hostile creatures within 5 blocks. It burns undead creatures and vampires, and it strips helpful effects from other hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.planted: Nothing moves you off the line. You are knocked back half as far.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.hallowe: Draw the line wider. A Hang Garlic cloud reaches 8 blocks in place of 5.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.incense: Sweet smoke vampires hate. Sprinkle also raises a line of incense 5 blocks wide ahead of you.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.unbroke: The watch does not end at midnight. With at least 25 Vigil at night, you gain Resistance II.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sunburs: A flash like early morning. Undead creatures and vampires within 8 blocks burn for 5 seconds and are blinded. Other hostile creatures are blinded for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sanctua: Here, and no further. A Hang Garlic cloud lasts 5 minutes, and Mirror reaches 24 blocks. Each use costs 10 Vigil more.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.last_wa: Where you stand, they cannot rest. With at least 50 Vigil at night, hostile creatures within 10 blocks suffer Garlic.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.false_d: For a moment, the sun comes up. Sunburst burns and blinds undead creatures and vampires for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.thresho: A line they will not cross. While you stand within 2 blocks of a door, undead creatures and vampires within 5 blocks are pushed back.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.hang_ga: A handful of crushed cloves. A garlic cloud hangs where you stand for 60 seconds. Undead creatures and vampires in it suffer Garlic and can barely move.
It shows what is there. Vampires, creatures in a costume and invisible creatures within 12 blocks are shown: they lose Invisibility and glow for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.true_si: Seen, and shaken. A creature shown by Mirror also suffers Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.last_li: Light meant for the dead alone. Undead creatures and vampires touched by Sprinkle or Sunburst can barely strike for 5 seconds. Your tools do nothing to the living.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.keen_: You smell them before you see them. At night, hostile creatures within 16 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.mark_: Remember that one. The creature you aim at within 24 blocks is marked and glows for 10 seconds.
Weights on a cord. The creature you aim at within 16 blocks suffers Slowness III for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.light: No twig snaps. At night, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.calle: It was always going to end here. Every marked creature within 24 blocks takes 5 damage.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.tangl: One throw, two catches. Bola also slows one marked creature within 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.no_es: The trail never goes cold. With at least 25 Vigil, marked creatures within 24 blocks suffer Slowness.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.apex_: Nothing hides from you. With at least 50 Vigil, hostile creatures within 24 blocks are marked.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.the_l: Days on the trail. Creatures marked by Mark Quarry and Read the Trail glow for 60 seconds. Each use costs 10 Vigil more.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.corne: Reel it in. Creatures struck by Called Shot are pulled toward you.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.first: Anything you hurt leaves a trail. When you hit a creature, it is marked.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.pack_: And the ones with it. Mark Quarry also marks creatures within 4 blocks of its target.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.read_: Every bent blade of grass. Every hostile creature within 32 blocks is marked and glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.tally: Count what you found. Read the Trail gives you 2 Vigil for each creature it marks.
The herd is thinned. Called Shot kills a marked creature below 20% health outright, and Bola holds such a creature in place for 6 seconds. Called Shot spends all your Vigil.
skill.townstead.hunter.keen_senses.descr: Nothing creeps up on you. At night, hostile creatures within 12 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.hunter.vigil.description: Someone has to stay awake. At night, you recover a large amount of energy.
contract.townstead.hunter.put_one_down.a: Something has been seen near town after dark. Find it and put it down.
contract.townstead.hunter.clear_a_nest.a: There's a place out there where they gather. Find it and thin them out.
contract.townstead.hunter.hold_the_fence: More than one is coming tonight. Keep them out of town.
contract.townstead.hunter.garlic.title: Garlic for the doors
contract.townstead.hunter.garlic.about: The lodge is running low on garlic. Bring some in.
contract.townstead.hunter.stakes.title: Stakes
contract.townstead.hunter.stakes.about: We go through stakes faster than anyone likes. Bring some.
contract.townstead.hunter.bolts.title: Bolts
contract.townstead.hunter.bolts.about: The crossbows are hungry. Bring bolts.
contract.townstead.hunter.fangs.title: Trophies
contract.townstead.hunter.fangs.about: Bring back proof. Fangs will do.
contract.townstead.hunter.the_bitten.abo: Someone in town has been bitten. Get garlic into their blood before it takes.
contract.townstead.hunter.the_bitten.goa: Cure someone who has been bitten
story_item.townstead.court_signet.lore: Dropped at a grave, not long ago.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.title: Oaths
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page1:
First. Come when you are called, whatever the hour.

Second. Wash your hands before, and after.

Third. Speak plainly to the frightened.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page2:
Fourth. Carry the lamp yourself.

Fifth. Keep what you are told.

Sixth. Turn no one away.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page3:
Seventh. Do no harm that you can help.

Eighth. Take nothing from the dying.

Ninth. Do not leave before it is finished.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page4: The quiet one brought his wine again tonight and stood behind my chair until I moved it. She does not like me. I do not think she likes anyone he looks at.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page5: He says I am safe while he is in the house. He has doubled the men at the gate. He sits up when he thinks I am asleep.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page6: If this book comes to anyone but me, give it to my child. Tell them the fourth one is the hardest. Carry the lamp yourself.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page7: Raining. He is away until the new moon. The quiet one has been kind to me all day, which frightens me more than anything she has done.
